paper.title: Semantic Bandits: In-Context Exploration-Exploitation is Biased by Semantic Priors
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-making agents in settings that require sophisticated environmental exploration. However, existing work has raised questions about how LLMs actually balance exploration and exploitation. Unlike classical agents, LLM agents engage with tasks through natural language, exposing them to semantic information with no formal counterpart in the task structure. We introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the multi-armed bandit settin

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 在 in-context bandit 决策里，探索—利用行为是否被动作文本标签和奖励语义先验系统性扭曲，而不是仅由形式化 reward structure 决定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发不在 bandit 方法本身，而在于它把一种典型的预训练遗留偏置讲得更清楚：模型在决策时并不是在抽象符号空间里更新策略，而是在自然语言表征上调用预训练中学到的语义联想。动作命名、奖励正负号、场景措辞都可能成为隐式先验。这对研究 RL-as-in-context learning、agent pretraining 接口、以及训练后对齐时的 prompt/rendering 敏感性都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 semantic bandit，把经典 multi-armed bandit 扩展为同时参数化形式任务结构与文本呈现方式的环境。核心变量包括：动作 nomenclature，也就是每个 arm 的自然语言标签；奖励极性与数值表达；以及场景文本。借这个框架，作者比较语义标签与真实 reward 分布对齐、错配或中性的情况，观察 LLM 是否会在极少探索下直接利用语义先验，或者被错误先验带偏。论文的贡献主要是评测设定和行为分析，而不是新的学习算法。
summary.experiments: 主要发现有三点。第一，动作标签显著影响探索行为：当高奖励 arm 配上正向语义标签时，模型会更快利用、累计 regret 更低；当标签与真实奖励错配时，同样的先验会把模型引向低奖励动作，regret 明显上升。第二，奖励极性本身是强上下文信号：负奖励会触发更多探索，说明模型并非把 reward 当作纯抽象数值，而是相对某种语义预期来解释。第三，这两类偏置会交互：在负奖励条件下，模型更不容易盲目依赖动作标签的语义先验。就研究深度看，这些结果更像对 ICRL 行为偏差的系统刻画，而不是对预训练机制的直接干预。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。先看 introduction 和 problem definition，理解作者为何认为经典 bandit 评测漏掉了语言表征这一变量；再看主实验图，重点关注 aligned / misaligned nomenclature 与 reward polarity 的对比。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要结论。如果关心 pretrain→agent 的接口，可以多看 discussion，思考这些偏置是 prompt artifact，还是预训练语义统计在决策中的稳定外显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether exploration–exploitation behavior in in-context bandit tasks is systematically biased by semantic priors from pretraining, rather than being driven only by the formal reward structure.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. The paper makes a useful point: LLM agents do not act in a stripped symbolic state space. They act through natural-language renderings, so pretrained associations about action names, reward wording, and scenario framing can shape decision behavior. That is relevant for in-context RL, agent evaluation, and the broader pretrain-to-posttrain interface, especially when prompt format or environment rendering changes behavior in ways classical RL abstractions would miss.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the semantic bandit, an extension of the standard multi-armed bandit that explicitly models not only the reward distributions but also the textual representation of actions and rewards. The main manipulated factors are action nomenclature, reward polarity, and scenario wording. They then compare settings where semantic labels are aligned with the true reward structure, misaligned with it, or neutral, and measure how LLMs explore and exploit under these different renderings. The contribution is primarily an evaluation framework plus behavioral analysis, not a new learning method.
summary_en.experiments: The main findings are straightforward. First, action labels strongly affect exploration: when high-reward arms receive semantically favorable names, models exploit quickly and incur lower regret; when the labels are misleading, the same priors push models toward worse arms and regret rises sharply. Second, reward polarity matters: negative rewards induce substantially more exploration than positive rewards, suggesting that models interpret rewards relative to semantic expectations rather than as purely abstract numbers. Third, these effects interact: under negative rewards, models rely less on semantic action-label priors. The paper is more about characterizing a failure mode in ICRL behavior than about intervening on pretraining itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough. Read the introduction and problem definition to see why the authors think classical bandit formulations miss an important variable for LLM agents. Then inspect the main figures comparing aligned versus misaligned nomenclature and positive versus negative reward settings. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to extract the core message. If you care about the pretrain-to-agent interface, the discussion section is the part worth lingering on.

recommendation.zh: 语义先验会系统性扭曲 LLM agent 的 bandit 探索，这对 agent 训练中动作命名、工具接口设计有直接启发，重点读 §3 设定与 §4 对齐/错位对比。
recommendation.en: Semantic priors systematically distort bandit-style exploration in LLM agents, with direct implications for action naming and tool-interface design in agent training; focus on §3 setup and §4 aligned/misaligned comparisons.

paper.title: StateM: Reaching 95.3% Raw Accuracy, or a \$15 Frontier Run, on Terminal-Bench 2.1 via Harness Scaling
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents can fail even when their underlying models can solve the constituent steps. They may lose track of mutable state, fail to reactivate lessons from earlier executions, skip known procedures, or stop prematurely. We bet on harness scaling to improve the execution system around an agent without changing its model weights. We introduce StateM, an agent-native runtime that organizes execution around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 即使底层模型能解每一步，也常因可变状态丢失、经验不复用、流程跳步或过早终止而失败。
summary.importance: 提出 harness scaling 思路：不改动模型权重，仅通过执行系统设计提升 Agent 长程表现，属于 Agent 系统范式的工程化探索。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 StateM 运行时，围绕持久状态、阶段局部上下文、带校验的状态转移、可恢复 runbook、版本化流程实践组织执行，Agent 与用户可共同检视。
summary.experiments: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，StateM 将 GPT-5.5 xhigh 从 83.1% 基准提升到 92.1%，超过 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 的 91.9%；搭配 GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh 达到 95.3% 原始准确率（445 次试验，89 个任务至少成功一次）；冻结配置将 GPT-5.6 Luna 从 76.7% 提升到 85.4%。
summary.authors_note: Zhangyang Atlas Wang（UT Austin）团队，长期从事视觉与 Agent 系统研究；Kai Wang 为共同通讯。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents often fail even when their base model can solve each step, due to lost mutable state, unreused prior experience, skipped procedures, or premature termination.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the harness scaling idea: improving agent performance purely through execution-system design without touching model weights — an engineering paradigm exploration for agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds StateM, an agent-native runtime organized around durable states, phase-local context, checked transitions, recoverable runbooks, and versioned procedural practices inspectable by both agent and user.
summary_en.experiments: On Terminal-Bench 2.1, StateM lifts GPT-5.5 xhigh from 83.1% baseline to 92.1%, exceeding GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra at 91.9%. With GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh it reaches 95.3% raw accuracy across 445 trials, succeeding on all 89 tasks at least once. A frozen profile raises GPT-5.6 Luna from 76.7% to 85.4%.
summary_en.authors_note: Zhangyang Atlas Wang's group at UT Austin, with long track record in vision and agent systems; Kai Wang is co-corresponding.

recommendation.zh: harness scaling 的提法有启发，但本质是把更多先验工程塞进运行时；看 §3 状态机设计和 Table 2 跨模型迁移性即可。
recommendation.en: The 'harness scaling' framing is suggestive, but it mostly packs more engineered priors into the runtime; read §3 on state-machine design and Table 2 on cross-model transfer.

paper.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization)

summary.core_problem: LLM agent部署需要满足工具使用、安全、格式等操作约束，但收集领域监督数据做后训练对多数从业者不可行。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无监督的约束感知prompt优化方法，无需监督数据即可在显式约束下优化系统prompt。
summary.technical_approach: CAPO采用primal-dual方法，结合基于池的prompt重写和自适应约束加权，在显式操作约束下优化系统prompt；进一步提出动态训练版本DCAPO。
summary.experiments: 在agent基准上更可靠达到可行操作点同时提升任务性能；在助手风格评测的输出格式、安全隐私约束场景下也取得不错效果。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者团队。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agent deployments require satisfying operational constraints (tool use, safety, formatting), but collecting domain-specific supervised data for post-training is infeasible for most practitioners.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes an unsupervised constraint-aware prompt optimization method that optimizes system prompts under explicit constraints without supervised data.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAPO uses a primal-dual method combining pool-based prompt rewrites with adaptive constraint weighting to optimize system prompts under explicit operational constraints; a dynamically trained variant DCAPO is also introduced.
summary_en.experiments: More reliably reaches empirically feasible operating points while improving task performance across agent benchmarks; also achieves strong results on assistant-style evaluations with output-format and safety/privacy constraints.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent researcher team.

recommendation.zh: 纯prompt层面的约束优化技巧，不涉及模型训练，作为部署侧参考即可。
recommendation.en: Pure prompt-level constraint optimization trick, no model training involved, useful only as deployment reference.

paper.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
paper.abstract: LLM agents in the ReAct paradigm alternate between reasoning, acting, and observing, but deliberate reasoning is confined to the Thought phase: while the agent serializes an action and waits for the environment, its reasoning is frozen. We identify this recurring interval for Action and Observation as a reasoning idle window and ask whether it can host additional reasoning in parallel that serves future turns. Therefore, we propose Second Thought, a training-free inference framework that forks f

summary.core_problem: 解决 ReAct Agent 在执行 action 和等待 observation 时主推理线程空闲、无法继续思考的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 推理调度和 inference-time 控制。它不是模型训练或预训练方法，但把环境等待时间变成并行思考窗口，对长链工具调用 Agent 的延迟和 token 分配有工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Second Thought，一个 training-free inference framework。在每个 Thought 阶段结束后，系统立即 fork 四个辅助 reasoning branches，与主循环并发解码；当环境 observation 返回时，再把辅助分支生成的 thoughts 合并回后续决策。核心是把额外 reasoning 从主线程的顺序解码路径中移出去。
summary.experiments: 在三个 agentic benchmarks 和三个 reasoning LLM 上评估。九个 model-benchmark 组合中平均 turn count 均下降；六个组合中主线程 decoding 最多减少 43%。摘要未给出具体模型名称、任务名称和成功率变化细节。
summary.authors_note: David Lo 是软件工程和自动化程序分析领域的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the idle interval in ReAct-style agents: once an action is issued and the agent waits for the environment, deliberate reasoning on the main path stops.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time agent scheduling method, not a pretraining result. It is useful for understanding how long-horizon tool agents can spend otherwise idle wall-clock time on future reasoning without lengthening the sequential decoding path.
summary_en.technical_approach: Second Thought is a training-free framework that forks four auxiliary reasoning branches immediately after each Thought phase. These branches decode concurrently with the main agent loop, and their generated thoughts are merged when the environment observation arrives. The key design is to move additional reasoning off the main thread.
summary_en.experiments: The method is tested on three agentic benchmarks and three reasoning LLMs. It reduces average turn count in all nine model-benchmark pairs and reduces main-thread decoding in six pairs, with reductions up to 43%. The abstract does not provide the exact model list, benchmark names, or detailed success-rate trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: David Lo is a well-known researcher in software engineering and automated program analysis.

recommendation.zh: 只看并行分支合并策略和失败案例；这是 Agent 调度技巧，不会改变 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: Skim only the branch-merging design and failure cases; this is an agent scheduling trick, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Beyond Retrieval: Query-Conditioned Reuse of Long-Horizon Agent Trajectories
paper.abstract: Retrieval can identify a past trajectory that may matter, yet it does not specify how an acting agent should use that trajectory after users, entities, constraints, or environment state have changed. We identify this post-retrieval reuse step as a distinct bottleneck for long-horizon trajectory memory and formulate an evaluation framework that holds candidate retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget fixed while varying the support delivered to the agent. We instantiate the frame

summary.core_problem: 长程Agent轨迹记忆中，检索到历史轨迹后如何适配变化的用户、实体、约束与环境状态的复用瓶颈。
summary.importance: 方法+评测贡献：明确将检索后复用作为独立问题，提出固定其他变量的评测框架，以及简单的查询条件复用（QCR）格式作为基线。
summary.technical_approach: 设计查询条件复用（QCR）：记录可复用过程、待恢复绑定、适用条件与验证要求的目标绑定笔记；配套评测框架固定检索、目标状态、模型、解码与工具预算，仅改变给Agent的支持形式。
summary.experiments: 在WebArena、WorkArena、AppWorld共2391个目标实例上测试，QCR平均成功率62.3%，比全轨迹基线高10.7个点，同时在线token用量减少48.9%。
summary.authors_note: 西安交通大学智能网络与网络安全教育部重点实验室，作者背景无公开知名信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The post-retrieval reuse bottleneck in long-horizon agent trajectory memory, where retrieved past trajectories cannot be straightforwardly applied after changes to users, entities, constraints, or environment state.
summary_en.importance: Method + evaluation contribution: explicitly identifies post-retrieval reuse as a distinct problem, proposes an evaluation framework that controls for confounding variables, and introduces a simple query-conditioned reuse (QCR) format as a baseline.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs Query-Conditioned Reuse (QCR), a target-bound note format recording reusable procedures, bindings to recover, applicability conditions, and verification requirements; pairs it with an evaluation framework that fixes retrieval, target state, model, decoding, and tool budget while only varying the support delivered to the agent.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 2,391 target instances across WebArena, WorkArena, and AppWorld; QCR achieves 62.3% average success rate, 10.7 points above the full-trajectory baseline, while using 48.9% fewer online tokens.
summary_en.authors_note: MOE Key Lab for Intelligent Networks and Network Security, Xi'an Jiaotong University; no publicly known prominent authors.

recommendation.zh: 把Agent轨迹复用从检索中拆出来单独研究的思路干净，但方法本身是工程性的笔记格式设计，对预训练无直接价值，作为Agent文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: The clean framing of trajectory reuse as a problem separate from retrieval is notable, but the method is an engineered note format with no direct pretraining value; keep as literature reference only.

institutions: MOE KLNN Lab, Xi’an Jiaotong University

paper.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
paper.abstract: Agent Skills are today either hand-authored or produced in a single LLM generation pass, and consequently possess no closed loop through which they might improve from the interaction failures they actually cause. Recent work does close this loop, but derives its feedback from single-turn question-answering evaluation. The consequence is a sharp asymmetry: once the first round has patched the gaps that a single exchange can reveal, the evolution gradient decays, the defects that surface only acro

summary.core_problem: 现有agent技能要么手写要么单轮生成，缺乏从实际交互失败中迭代的闭环；单轮QA反馈的进化梯度会快速衰减，多轮交互才会暴露的缺陷无法被发现，导致进化停滞。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于多轮交互反馈的技能进化框架，解决单轮反馈下进化梯度衰减的问题，同时替代端到端标量验证分实现结构化故障定位与修复。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillEvo框架，利用多轮交互反馈提供可信的持续进化梯度，替代单轮QA反馈和端到端标量验证门，实现技能的自我迭代与结构化故障修复（摘要截断，方法细节未完全披露）。
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，未披露实验设置、基线模型与量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Current agent skills are either hand-authored or generated in a single pass, with no closed loop for improvement from real interaction failures; single-turn QA feedback leads to fast-decaying evolution gradients, leaving multi-turn-only defects undetected and stalling evolution.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a skill evolution framework based on multi-turn interaction feedback, addressing evolution gradient decay under single-turn feedback and enabling structured fault localization and repair instead of end-to-end scalar verification.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SkillEvo, which leverages multi-turn interaction feedback to provide trustworthy sustained evolution gradients, replacing single-turn QA feedback and end-to-end scalar verification gates for self-renewing skill evolution and structured fault repair (abstract truncated, full method details undisclosed).
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; no experimental setup, baselines, or quantitative results disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 多轮交互反馈提供持续进化梯度的思路对agent技能迭代有参考，和预训练关系较远，仅看方法部分的反馈机制设计即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of sustained evolution gradients from multi-turn interaction feedback is useful for agent skill iteration. Low relevance to pretraining; only skim the feedback mechanism design in the method section.

paper.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release
paper.abstract: News DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release 2026/08/13 On this page DeepSeek-V4-Pro GA Release We’re launching DeepSeek-V4-Pro today! 🚀 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains! 🔷 Flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro & V4-Flash: low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent workflows, max for complex tasks. 🔷 Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup. V4 Pro is now available on app/web. Try it via “Expert Mode”. V4 Pro is also available via API. Model names remain

summary.core_problem: 这是一条 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的正式发布公告，主要解决产品可用性问题：向网页端和 API 用户开放 V4-Pro，并强化 Agent 工作流、推理强度调节和 Codex 接入体验。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接技术价值很低。公告没有披露模型架构、训练数据、训练流程、参数规模或评测结果。唯一值得注意的信号是 V4-Pro 将 Agent 能力作为主要升级方向，并提供 low/high/max 三档推理强度，这间接反映了生产环境中按任务复杂度分配推理算力的需求，但没有给出实现机制。
summary.technical_approach: 没有技术方案细节。已公开的变化包括：V4-Pro 与 V4-Flash 支持可调节推理强度；low 用于简单任务，high 用于日常 Agent 工作流，max 用于复杂任务；原生支持 OpenAI Responses API；针对 Codex 做了接入优化；网页端可通过 Expert Mode 使用；API 模型名保持不变；同时引入峰时和非峰时定价，非峰时价格低 50%。
summary.experiments: 没有实验。公告只声称有“strong production gains”，但没有给出 benchmark、消融实验、参数量、训练数据规模、延迟、吞吐或任务成功率等任何可验证数字。
summary.reading_guide: 这不是研究论文，全文只有几段产品说明，阅读时间约 1 到 2 分钟。若关注 DeepSeek 的产品节奏、API 定价或 Agent 服务形态，可以浏览；若关注基座预训练技术，可以跳过，因为没有可复用的方法、数据或训练细节。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek。公告未列出具体作者。

summary_en.core_problem: This is a general-availability announcement for DeepSeek-V4-Pro. It addresses product availability and usability: opening V4-Pro on web and API, improving agent workflows, adding adjustable reasoning effort, and simplifying Codex integration.
summary_en.importance: The direct technical value for pretraining research is minimal. The post discloses no architecture, training data, training recipe, parameter count, or evaluation results. The only useful signal is that V4-Pro positions agent capabilities as a major upgrade and offers low/high/max reasoning effort, suggesting production demand for allocating inference compute by task complexity, but the mechanism is not described.
summary_en.technical_approach: No technical approach is provided. The announced changes are: flexible reasoning effort for V4-Pro and V4-Flash, with low for simple tasks, high for daily agent workflows, and max for complex tasks; native OpenAI Responses API support; Codex-optimized setup; web access through Expert Mode; unchanged API model names; and peak/off-peak pricing with off-peak rates 50% lower.
summary_en.experiments: There are no experiments. The announcement claims “strong production gains” but provides no benchmarks, ablations, parameter counts, training data sizes, latency, throughput, or task success rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a short product announcement rather than a research paper, readable in one or two minutes. It is worth skimming only for tracking DeepSeek’s release cadence, API pricing, or agent serving direction. For base-model pretraining research, it can be skipped because it contains no reusable methods, data details, or training insights.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek. No individual authors are listed.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek V4-Pro 正式发布，重点关注其引入的 'flexible reasoning effort' 机制，这印证了 test-time compute scaling 正成为基座模型的标配能力。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek V4-Pro GA release highlights the 'flexible reasoning effort' mechanism, confirming that test-time compute scaling is becoming a standard feature for foundation models.

paper.title: RLMOpt: Adaptive Prompt Optimization via Recursive Language Models
paper.abstract: Prompt optimizers automate the search for prompts that improve language-model performance, but existing methods rely on a predefined optimization procedure: the algorithm determines which candidates to explore and how the search progresses, while the language model generates or refines prompt proposals. We introduce RLMOpt, a prompt optimizer that makes the search policy itself language-model-driven through a recursive language model (RLM). The RLM agent operates over a tool-based environment, i

summary.core_problem: 现有prompt优化方法依赖预定义的搜索流程，无法自适应调整搜索策略、评估预算与停止时机。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出递归LM驱动的自适应prompt优化框架，将搜索策略本身交由LM agent决策，而非固定算法。
summary.technical_approach: 构建递归语言模型agent，在工具环境中执行任务信息检查、失败分析、候选生成、评估预算分配、停止决策等操作；辅以确定性执行框架，负责客观打分、帕累托选择与回归约束。
summary.experiments: 在4个基准（Chia临床信息抽取、HotpotQA多跳QA、IFBench-2025可验证指令跟随、BFCL多轮工具调用）上评估，效果优于现有prompt优化方法（摘要未披露具体提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing prompt optimization methods rely on predefined search procedures and cannot adaptively adjust search strategies, evaluation budgets, and stopping criteria.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation of an adaptive prompt optimization framework driven by a recursive language model, where the search policy itself is decided by an LM agent rather than a fixed algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a recursive language model agent that operates in a tool-based environment to inspect task information, analyze failures, generate candidates, allocate evaluation budget, and decide when to stop; complemented by a deterministic harness for objective scoring, Pareto-based selection, and regression constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 4 benchmarks (Chia clinical IE, HotpotQA multi-hop QA, IFBench-2025 verifiable instruction following, BFCL multi-turn tool calling), outperforming existing prompt optimization methods (specific improvement margins not disclosed in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 自适应prompt优化的agent方法，思路有一定新意，但与预训练核心问题距离较远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Agent-based adaptive prompt optimization with some novelty, but far from core pretraining problems; abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agents accumulate reusable skills by appending successful procedures and failure fixes. Over time, the same requirement is often restated in several branches, examples, and warnings, while common action sequences are copied rather than reused. The resulting skill becomes expensive to inject and difficult to maintain. Generic prompt compression is ill-suited to this setting because a skill is not a flat passage: its name and description define when it applies, its workflow controls

summary.core_problem: 自进化Agent积累的技能库存在大量冗余（重复规则、重复动作序列），导致注入成本高、维护困难，普通prompt压缩不适用技能的结构化特性，评测引导的压缩又存在rollout成本高、依赖评测集的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新；首次提出无需评测的Agent技能结构化压缩方法，解决自进化Agent技能库膨胀的痛点
summary.technical_approach: 原创SkillZip方法，核心是寻找技能的最短忠实结构解释，遵循“一次解释，多次引用”的直觉：将技能的结构化组件（适用条件、工作流、工具契约、异常处理）中的重复规则提取为公共引用，而非重复陈述，在不依赖评测rollout的前提下保证压缩后的技能行为忠实
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型参数量、baseline及量化效果数据，需查阅正文补充

summary_en.core_problem: Skill libraries accumulated by self-evolving agents contain heavy redundancy (repeated rules, duplicated action sequences), leading to high injection costs and maintenance difficulty; generic prompt compression fails to handle structured skills, while evaluation-guided compression incurs high rollout costs and relies on evaluation sets
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes the first evaluation-free structured skill compression method for self-evolving agents, addressing the skill library bloat pain point
summary_en.technical_approach: Original SkillZip method that finds the shortest faithful structural explanation of a skill, following the "explain once, reference many" intuition: extracts repeated rules across structured skill components (applicability conditions, workflows, tool contracts, exception handling) as shared references instead of redundant statements, ensuring behavioral faithfulness without evaluation rollouts
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific experimental setups, model sizes, baselines, or quantitative performance results; refer to the full text for details

recommendation.zh: 属于Agent侧的prompt结构化压缩方法，和预训练基座关联较弱，仅做领域动态了解即可
recommendation.en: A structured prompt compression method for agent-side skills, with weak relevance to LLM base pretraining; only track as domain dynamics

paper.title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
paper.abstract: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate Doc

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长文档理解中的交互式证据获取问题：相关信息分散在很多页、表格、图像和图表中，静态 RAG 一次性取回证据不够灵活，而纯 prompt 驱动的 agent 又难以被系统训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法，但对基座和 post-train 接口有参考意义。它把长文档问答从“把更多内容塞进上下文”改成“在可变环境中学习搜索、阅读、记笔记和复查”。这个形式更接近可训练的 agent environment：同一套交互协议既用于推理，也用于 RL 训练小模型。对长上下文模型研究来说，它提醒一个现实问题：扩大 context window 不能替代信息选择、状态管理和证据压缩。
summary.technical_approach: DocAtlas 被定义为 mutable document harness。给定文档和问题，环境维护四类状态：原始文档、层级文档树、结构化 note store、已探索页面集合。agent 每一步选择工具动作，环境根据当前状态返回 observation。核心工具包括 Search、Read、Note、Review 和最终 Finish。Search 不是在固定索引上检索，而是读取已被 Note 和探索记录更新过的状态；Read 将页面以 markdown、crop、page image 等形式暴露给 VLM；Note 把带来源的发现写回树和笔记库；Review 在后续推理中重新调出已有证据。这样，后续检索会受到早期发现的影响，避免每一步都从静态文档表示重新开始。与传统 RAG 相比，它强调状态可变；与只靠 prompt 的 agent 相比，它提供了可以在训练和推理阶段复用的环境接口；与 DocDancer 相比，它不只训练文本控制器调用外部 VLM，而是允许 VLM agent 在同一环境中端到端 RL。
summary.experiments: 论文在 MMLongBench-Doc 上报告了两个关键结果。使用 GPT-5.4 作为 backbone 的 DocAtlas 达到 71.4%，高于文中给出的 human-expert reference 65.8%。使用 Qwen3.5-4B VLM 在同一环境中做端到端 RL 后达到 63.7%，相比 direct-input baseline 的 54.4% 提升 9.3 个百分点。这个结果说明，收益不只来自更强闭源模型，也来自交互协议和可训练环境本身。提供内容未包含完整消融表，无法确认 Search、Read、Note、Review 各组件的单独贡献和 RL 训练细节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟左右。重点看 Method 中对 trajectory、tool action、environment state 的形式化定义，以及 Search/Read/Note/Review 如何更新状态。实验部分建议优先找 MMLongBench-Doc 的主结果表、RL tuning 设置、以及是否有去掉 Note、Review、mutable tree 的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得深挖的是它的环境接口是否能扩展为通用 long-context / multimodal agent 的 SFT 和 RL 数据生成器。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-document understanding as an interactive evidence-seeking problem. Relevant information may be scattered across pages, tables, figures, and charts. Static RAG retrieves a fixed evidence set before generation, while many agentic systems rely on prompt-defined behavior over frozen proprietary models.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the interface between foundation models, long-context inference, and RL training. The main lesson is that long-document capability is not only a context-length problem. A model also needs mechanisms for selective reading, stateful memory, evidence attribution, and revisiting previous findings. DocAtlas provides an environment that can be used both at inference time and during RL, which makes it more useful for training compact open VLM agents than a prompt-only tool-use recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: DocAtlas instantiates a mutable document harness. For each document-question pair, the environment maintains the document, a hierarchical tree, a structured note store, and the set of explored pages. The agent produces a trajectory of tool calls and ends with a Finish action. Search operates over the current mutable state rather than a fixed index. Read exposes selected pages through markdown, crops, and full page images. Note records source-attributed findings and writes them back into the tree and note store. Review retrieves earlier notes when later reasoning needs them. This design lets later retrieval depend on earlier evidence, which is the main difference from static RAG. It also differs from prompt-only document agents because the same action interface can be used for RL. Compared with DocDancer, the agent is not just a text controller that delegates visual understanding to an external VLM; the VLM policy can be trained inside the same environment.
summary_en.experiments: On MMLongBench-Doc, DocAtlas with GPT-5.4 reaches 71.4%, compared with a reported human-expert reference of 65.8%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM fine-tuned with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7%, while the direct-input baseline is 54.4%, a 9.3-point gain. These numbers suggest that the mutable interaction protocol contributes beyond simply using a stronger backbone. The supplied content does not include the full ablation tables, so the separate effects of Search, Read, Note, Review, and the RL recipe cannot be checked here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Focus on the method section defining trajectories, tool actions, observations, and mutable environment state. Then inspect the main MMLongBench-Doc result table and any ablations removing note-taking, review, or the mutable tree. For foundation-model researchers, the most useful question is whether this environment can serve as a scalable generator of SFT/RL trajectories for long-context multimodal agents.

recommendation.zh: 读系统状态设计和 note store 更新规则；这是外部记忆工程，不是长上下文预训练替代品。
recommendation.en: Read the state design and note-store update rules; this is external-memory engineering, not a replacement for long-context pretraining.

paper.title: LLM within MCP Matters: Measuring Inefficient Resource Utilization Driven by LLMs
paper.abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how servers expose data and tools to Large Language Models (LLMs). A common server design embeds frequently used reference data, such as identifier lookup tables, directly in the server instructions: the system-prompt text a server hands to the host application. When a query concerns an entry of the embedded table, the model can act on it immediately instead of re-discovering the same information through a search tool. We test whether client LLMs act

summary.core_problem: MCP 服务器常将参考数据嵌入 system prompt，但客户端 LLM 是否真正消费这些嵌入数据、还是偏向调用搜索工具？
summary.importance: 大规模行为研究（54k 试验、24 个模型），揭示 LLM 在工具可用时会主动忽略已嵌入上下文的信息，失败主因是行为偏好而非能力缺失。
summary.technical_approach: 在生产级法律信息 MCP 服务器上设置对照实验：移除搜索工具的诊断条件 vs 搜索工具存在的条件；2^3 因子分析拆解影响因素。
summary.experiments: 24 个模型（9 Claude、6 Gemini、9 GPT），54,000 次试验。无搜索工具时 23/24 模型嵌入数据命中率≥98%；有搜索工具时 9 个模型命中率降至 15% 以下。

summary_en.core_problem: Do client LLMs actually consume reference data embedded in MCP server system prompts, or do they prefer invoking search tools instead?
summary_en.importance: Large-scale behavioral study (54k trials, 24 models) showing that LLMs ignore embedded context when a search tool is present; failures stem from behavioral preference, not capability gaps.
summary_en.technical_approach: Controlled experiment on a production legal-information MCP server: diagnostic condition with search removed vs. condition with search present; 2^3 factorial analysis to isolate factors.
summary_en.experiments: 24 models (9 Claude, 6 Gemini, 9 GPT), 54,000 trials. Without search, 23/24 models achieve ≥98% hit ratio on embedded data; with search merely present, 9 models drop below 15%.

recommendation.zh: 结论干净：模型不是读不到上下文，而是工具在场时偏不去读。做 agent 训练或 prompt 设计时值得知道，但对 pretrain 无直接动作。
recommendation.en: Clean finding: models can read embedded context but choose not to when a tool is present. Useful for agent/prompt design, no direct pretrain action.

paper.title: REVEAL: A Rubric-Guided Agent for Explicit Evidence Sufficiency Verificationin Long-Video Question Answering
paper.abstract: Recently, retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented methods have emerged as two promising paradigms for long-video question answering. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid, fixed-length temporal chunking (e.g., 10s) and static offline memory banks, which not only fragment coherent continuous events but also fail to adapt during real-time reasoning. Moreover, whether using multi-scale summaries or multimodal knowledge graphs, current approaches prioritize retrieval relevance while ove

summary.core_problem: 长视频问答中现有方法依赖固定时长切片与静态记忆库，且仅关注检索相关性而忽略证据充分性，导致关键时序/因果证据缺失时仍提前作答。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出基于评分规则引导的智能体框架，结合自适应事件切分与显式证据充分性校验，改进长视频推理流程。
summary.technical_approach: 提出REVEAL框架：1) 基于视觉相似度的自适应预处理，将相邻连贯帧聚合为自然事件单元，构建离线+在线视频记忆；2) 评分规则引导的智能体在推理中动态校验证据是否充分，不足时继续检索补充。
summary.experiments: 在长视频问答任务上对比检索增强与记忆增强基线，验证自适应事件切分与证据充分性校验的有效性，具体指标未在摘要中披露。
summary.authors_note: Cohere 团队工作

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-video QA methods rely on fixed-length temporal chunks and static memory banks, and stop answering once semantically relevant clues are found without verifying evidence sufficiency on temporal/causal details.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a rubric-guided agent framework that combines adaptive event segmentation and explicit evidence sufficiency verification for long-video reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: REVEAL framework: 1) adaptive visual-similarity-based preprocessing that groups coherent frames into natural event units and builds an offline-online video memory; 2) a rubric-guided agent that dynamically checks whether collected evidence is sufficient during reasoning and retrieves more if needed.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented baselines on long-video QA; concrete metrics are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Cohere

recommendation.zh: 属于长视频QA领域的应用型Agent改进，证据充分性校验思路可迁移到长上下文RAG，但整体与基座预训练距离较远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: An applied agent improvement for long-video QA; the evidence-sufficiency idea is transferable to long-context RAG, but it is distant from base pretraining—abstract is enough.

paper.title: MemeMind: Reference-Guided Trace Construction for Offline Context Optimization
paper.abstract: Offline context optimization improves an agent by revising its instructions and examples while keeping the model frozen. This approach learns from rollouts on an adaptation set, but some queries produce only failed rollouts. In these cases, the optimizer sees no successful example of how the available tools can reach the correct answer. We introduce MemeMind, which uses an offline reference answer to recover this missing experience. TraceBuilder identifies the evidence required by the reference,

summary.core_problem: 解决离线 context optimization 中失败轨迹缺少可学习成功示例的问题，尤其是在多工具、多模态 meme 理解任务里。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent 指令和示例的离线优化方法，模型保持冻结；价值在于把参考答案转成可验证工具轨迹，但任务域偏窄。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemeMind。TraceBuilder 从离线参考答案反推所需证据，调用文本搜索、图像检索和视觉定位工具，并验证工具轨迹后写入 adaptation buffer；ToolGuide 再把轨迹归纳成共享 guide 和各工具专属指令。参考答案只在适配阶段使用，推理阶段只使用学到的 guide。
summary.experiments: 实验场景是 Anime、Comic 和 Game meme interpretation。摘要未给出底座模型、适配集规模、工具配置、baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failed-rollout cases in offline context optimization, where an agent has no successful trace to learn from, with a focus on multimodal meme interpretation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an offline instruction/example optimization method for frozen agents. Its useful idea is converting reference answers into verified tool traces, though the application setting is narrow.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemeMind has two components. TraceBuilder uses offline reference answers to infer required evidence, executes text search, image retrieval, and visual grounding, verifies the resulting tool trace, and stores it in an adaptation buffer. ToolGuide then summarizes collected traces into a shared guide and per-tool instructions. References are used only during adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on Anime, Comic, and Game meme interpretation. The abstract does not report model scale, adaptation-set size, tool details, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 可看作“用答案反推工具轨迹”的 prompt 优化小技巧，读方法框架即可，meme 任务不必深究。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small prompt-optimization trick that backsolves tool traces from answers; read the method sketch, not the meme-specific setup.

paper.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
paper.abstract: Privileged on-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multi-turn agents by allowing a synchronized teacher to re-score the student's response at every turn with access to training-only references, such as successful trajectories. In interactive environments, however, the student's preceding actions continually change the execution state. As the student takes different actions or completes subgoals in a different order, its rollout may reach states not covered by the reference, making

summary.core_problem: 多轮 agent 训练中，特权 on-policy 蒸馏因学生执行状态偏离参考轨迹而产生状态-参考错配，导致指导信号不可靠。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出状态匹配路由 + 上下文自蒸馏，解决多轮 agent 蒸馏中的状态错配问题。
summary.technical_approach: SMRC-SD 显式判断特权轨迹何时/如何指导当前 on-policy 状态，并通过上下文自蒸馏让学生在无可靠参考时自我学习。
summary.experiments: 在交互式多轮 agent 环境中验证，对比普通特权蒸馏，减少状态错配带来的训练噪声。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-turn agent training, privileged on-policy distillation suffers from state-reference mismatch as the student's rollout diverges from the reference trajectory.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: state-matched routing + contextualized self-distillation to fix state-reference mismatch in multi-turn agent distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMRC-SD explicitly decides when and how a privileged trajectory should guide the current on-policy state, and uses contextualized self-distillation when no reliable reference exists.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated in interactive multi-turn agent environments, reducing training noise from state mismatch compared to vanilla privileged distillation.

recommendation.zh: agent 蒸馏方法的小改进，状态匹配思路对 RL 训练有借鉴，但非预训练核心，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A small improvement in agent distillation; the state-matching idea is mildly relevant to RL training but not core to pretraining—read abstract only.

paper.title: Project2Task: Graph-Guided Project-Level Planning for Autonomous Research
paper.abstract: Research agents can increasingly search literature, propose hypotheses, generate code, run experiments, and draft manuscripts from a single topic. However, a research project is not merely a larger task: it is a long-horizon agenda that must be advanced through multiple bounded tasks with distinct but related objectives, parallel alternatives, and dependency-aware sequences. Existing single-task systems often treat the project as one oversized task, produce a flat set of vague or overlapping tas

summary.core_problem: 现有 research agent 把整个项目当成一个超大任务，产出扁平、模糊、重叠的子任务，缺乏依赖关系与边界管理。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出图引导的项目级规划层，将研究项目分解为有依赖关系的 bounded tasks。
summary.technical_approach: Project2Task 把候选贡献表示为 innovation atoms，组织成有向 lineage graph；用轻量 Bernoulli block-model 目标在水平/垂直/混合分解中选择，生成有明确贡献归属的 bounded tasks。
summary.experiments: 在自主研究任务上验证，对比单任务系统，任务边界更清晰、执行顺序更合理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing research agents treat an entire project as one oversized task, producing flat, vague, overlapping subtasks without dependency or boundary management.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: a graph-guided project-level planning layer that decomposes a research project into dependency-aware bounded tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Project2Task represents candidate contributions as innovation atoms organized in a directed lineage graph; a lightweight Bernoulli block-model objective selects among horizontal, vertical, and hybrid decompositions to produce bounded tasks with explicit contribution ownership.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on autonomous research tasks, producing clearer task boundaries and more sensible execution order than single-task systems.

recommendation.zh: 研究 agent 的规划层设计，与预训练关系远，作为 agent 长程规划的方法参考即可。
recommendation.en: A planning-layer design for research agents; far from pretraining, useful only as a reference for long-horizon agent planning.

paper.title: Search2Skill: Skill Distillation Beyond Knowledge Boundaries Via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reusable skills, which encapsulate the procedural knowledge required to solve real-world professional tasks, offer LLM-based agents a path toward self-evolution in expert domains. Existing self-evolving skill methods construct skills internally from the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories, and are therefore bounded by what the model already knows. However, the domain conventions and standard procedures underlying professional skills often lie beyond this boundary and are hard to elicit

summary.core_problem: 现有自进化 skill 方法依赖模型自身参数知识或轨迹，无法获取模型知识边界之外的专业领域规范与标准流程。
summary.importance: 方法创新：通过外部搜索填补能力缺口，并用 rubric-based RL 联合优化何时搜、怎么搜、怎么生成 skill。
summary.technical_approach: Search2Skill 自动识别 agent 能力缺口 → 外部搜索证据 → 蒸馏为结构化可复用 skill；用基于 rubric 的强化学习同时优化搜索时机、搜索策略与 skill 生成。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个专家级领域、3 个 benchmark 上验证，相比内部构造 skill 的方法在专业任务上表现更好。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolving skill methods rely on the model's parametric knowledge or trajectories and cannot acquire domain conventions and standard procedures beyond the model's knowledge boundary.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: fills capability gaps via external search and uses rubric-based RL to jointly optimize when to search, how to search, and how to generate skills.
summary_en.technical_approach: Search2Skill automatically identifies agent capability gaps, searches external sources for evidence, and distills it into structured reusable skills; a rubric-based RL scheme jointly optimizes search timing, search strategy, and skill generation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on eight expert-level domains across three benchmarks, outperforming methods that build skills internally from parametric knowledge.

recommendation.zh: agent 自进化 + 外部检索的常规组合，rubric-based RL 是亮点但非预训练核心，看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: A standard combination of agent self-evolution and external retrieval; rubric-based RL is the main novelty but not core to pretraining—read the method section only.

paper.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, proce

summary.core_problem: 长时程 agent 执行中，初始目标经常是不完备甚至错误的，agent 必须能够在不偏离用户真实意图的前提下修订操作目标；但允许修订又会引入目标漂移——失败和合理 pivot 在外部观测上不可区分。现有系统要么固定目标禁止 pivot，要么在长轨迹上丢失证据、让执行者自行验收，导致安全性与连续性同时失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 和 agent runtime 设计有参考价值：它把“目标不是固定 supervison，而是带证据、带权限、带记录的演化合同”这个视角讲清楚了，对理解长程推理中模型需要什么样的状态表示、验证器接口、以及 self-evolution 是否可在不更新参数的情况下通过外部状态实现，提供了一个清晰的工程抽象。
summary.technical_approach: Argus 把长任务拆成 bounded missions 序列，围绕 durable project state 运行。四类角色分权：Manager 锚定意图与 campaign 状态，Planner 选下一个工作单元，Engineer 执行和评估，Reviewer 独立验收；低风险任务可走记录式 self-review。三个平面（control / execution / records）把调度、执行、记录分开。工作合同显式表示为 K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t)，其中 ι 是不变的用户意图，o_t 是当前操作目标，c_t 是约束，v_t 是验证准则。目标、约束或验证准则的更新必须由证据触发、通过对应权限角色 admission、并写入持久记录；只有能降低未来任务风险或成本的更新才被视为 compounding。论文将这一机制称为 verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution：模型参数不变，但后续 mission 从演化过的搜索策略、技能、verifier、路由决策开始，而非仅从更长的 transcript 开始。
summary.experiments: 评估分为三部分：(1) 七个 benchmark arena，覆盖软件修复、GPU kernel、语言模型训练、训练速度、研究助理任务、数学数据合成；报告 SWE-Bench Pro 结果，AARRI-Bench 76.8%，数学数据合成 gap 28.0，均高于文中引用的参考值。(2) 731 个 SWE-Bench Pro 任务的长程轨迹分析，观察 Skill/Wiki 演化、verifier recovery、Reviewer 干预、成熟阶段运行成本变化。(3) 纵向部署观察，记录 41 个 research artifacts across six programs，但多数为内部系统验证案例，以定性使用反馈为主，缺少公开、对照的零干预率统计。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看第 3 节关于 K_t 合同更新规则、第 6 节关于 self-evolution 的纵向观察，以及 introduction 中对 pivot vs drift 的区分。不必细抠 benchmark 数字，因为评估以部署观察和内部案例为主，对照不严格。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon agent execution, the initial objective is often underspecified or wrong, so the agent must be able to revise operational objectives without silently abandoning the user’s standing intent. But allowing revision introduces goal drift: principled pivots and outright failure are externally indistinguishable. Existing systems either fix the objective and forbid pivots, or lose evidence on long transcripts and let the executor certify its own completion, breaking both safety and continuity.
summary_en.importance: Direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the paper is useful for post-training and agent-runtime design. It articulates a clean abstraction in which the objective is not a fixed supervision target but an evolving contract with evidence, authority, and records. That framing is helpful for thinking about what state representations, verifier interfaces, and forms of self-improvement long-horizon systems need, including fixed-model self-evolution mediated by external state rather than parameter updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argus structures a long campaign as a sequence of bounded missions over a durable project state. Four model-driven roles split authority: a Manager anchors intent and campaign state, a Planner selects the next unit of work, an Engineer implements and evaluates it, and a Reviewer independently inspects artifacts before issuing completion verdicts; low-risk tasks may use recorded Engineer self-review. These roles operate across three planes—control, execution, and records—so scheduling, execution, and bookkeeping stay separable. The working contract is written explicitly as K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t), where ι is the invariant user intent, o_t the current operational objective, c_t the constraints, and v_t the verification criteria. Material updates to the objective, constraints, or verifier require evidence, admission by the authorized role, and durable logging; an accepted update counts as compounding only when it reduces future task risk or cost. The mechanism is called verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution: model parameters stay fixed, but later missions start from an evolved search policy with retained routes, measurements, verdicts, reusable skills, verifiers, and routing decisions rather than merely a longer transcript.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is organized in three parts. First, seven benchmark arenas cover software repair, GPU kernels, language-model training, training speed, research-assistant tasks, and mathematical data synthesis; reported numbers include SWE-Bench Pro results, 76.8% on AARRI-Bench, and a 28.0 gap on mathematical-data synthesis, all above referenced baselines. Second, a 731-task SWE-Bench Pro trajectory supports longitudinal analyses of Skill/Wiki evolution, verifier recovery, Reviewer intervention, and mature-stage operating cost. Third, deployment evidence includes 41 research artifacts across six programs, but many cases are internal system-verification episodes and are reported qualitatively; no controlled zero-touch rate is provided for the public traces.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the K_t contract-update formalism, Section 6 for the longitudinal self-evolution observations, and the introduction’s framing of pivot versus drift. Do not over-weight the benchmark numbers, since much of the evidence is observational and based on internal deployments rather than controlled comparisons. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 固定权重下仅靠运行时状态自进化就拿到SWE-Bench Pro 19点提升，token效率很高，值得关注其验证门控的设计细节
recommendation.en: A 19-point gain on SWE-Bench Pro via runtime state self-evolution without weight updates is highly token-efficient; the verification gating design is worth examining

paper.title: Screenshots or Tools? Eliciting Tool Use and Managing Multimodal Context in Hybrid GUI-MCP Computer-Use Agents
paper.abstract: Hybrid computer-use agents can act through screenshots or call text tools. We find that having a tool available does not settle which way the effect goes. Under one identical GUI-MCP harness on the OSWorld-MCP benchmark (309 tasks), the same MCP tools improve a reasoning model by +4.0pp and degrade a non-reasoning model by -5.9pp (5 runs each, both beyond 2 SE). What separates the two is tool-decision behavior. The non-reasoning policy ignores, misnames, or falsely terminates around tools. The r

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究混合 GUI-MCP computer-use agent 中的一个具体失配：工具已经暴露给模型，但模型是否真的会选择工具，而不是继续走截图点击路径。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更偏 agent 行为诊断和部署 recipe。但它给多模态 agent 训练提供了一个有用信号：工具可用性、工具注入和工具使用能力不是一回事。模型如果没有在训练中学到工具语义和何时切换观察通道，推理时加入工具可能降低性能，也可能只降低成本而不提升成功率。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在同一个 OSWorld-MCP harness 下比较 Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 和 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。GUI primitive actions 和 MCP tools 被放在同一个 tool_call 接口里，模型每步必须在截图操作和文本工具调用之间自行选择。工具通过 BM25 按当前应用检索 top-18，工具库包含 9 个应用 namespace、120 个工具。作者把问题拆成两层：action level 关注是否调用工具；context level 关注工具调用成功后是否还保留下一帧截图。这个设计比单纯比较“有无工具”更清楚，因为它能区分工具注入、工具选择、工具能力和观察压缩几个因素。
summary.experiments: 核心实验使用 OSWorld-MCP test_all_no_internet 的 309 个任务，每个设置 5 次 greedy decoding 运行，max_steps=50。相同工具和 harness 下，Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking 加入 MCP 后提升 +4.0 pp；Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 下降 -5.9 pp，差异均超过 2 个标准误。非 reasoning 模型常见错误包括忽略工具、工具名写错、围绕工具误终止。reasoning 模型更少出现这些错误，但仍只在 55/309 个任务上调用工具，只覆盖 tool-reachable 任务的 23.9%。VLC 子集里 16/17 个任务可由工具触达，但模型一次也没有调用工具。RL probe 显示，给工具调用加 dense post-normalization bonus 可以把 adoption 提高一个数量级，并且迁移到 greedy decoding；但 held-out accuracy 没有跟随提升，说明奖励能推动“选择工具”，不能补上“会用工具”。context-level 实验显示，工具成功后下一帧截图经常冗余；按部署时的观察规则重新训练，可以在约一半输入成本下保持精度，不再出现 observation rule mismatch 带来的分布外损失。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3.1–3.2 的条件性工具效果和 adoption gap，Section 5.2 的 RL probe，以及 Section 4.2/5.3 关于工具成功后截图压缩的实验。对基座研究员而言，值得带走的是训练信号问题：工具调用不是靠推理时注入自然涌现出来的能力，尤其不是低成本路径已经存在时模型就会自动采用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete mismatch in hybrid GUI-MCP computer-use agents: tools may be available, but the model may still prefer the screenshot-and-click route.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect. The useful signal is about multimodal agent training rather than foundation-model pretraining itself. Tool availability, tool injection, and tool competence are separated cleanly. Without training signals that teach tool semantics and when to switch observation channels, adding tools at inference time can hurt accuracy or only reduce cost without improving task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct under the same OSWorld-MCP harness. GUI primitives and MCP tools share one tool_call interface, so the model must choose between visual interaction and textual tools at every step. The tool inventory contains 120 tools across 9 application namespaces, retrieved with BM25 top-18 conditioned on the active application. The analysis separates two decisions: at the action level, whether to call a tool; at the context level, whether to keep the next screenshot after a successful tool call. This is stronger than a simple with-tools versus without-tools comparison because it isolates injection, adoption, competence, and observation compression.
summary_en.experiments: The main benchmark is OSWorld-MCP test_all_no_internet with 309 tasks, five greedy runs per setting, and max_steps=50. With the same tools and harness, MCP improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking by +4.0 percentage points but degrades Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct by -5.9 percentage points, both beyond 2 standard errors. The non-reasoning model often ignores tools, emits invalid tool names, or terminates incorrectly around tools. The reasoning model avoids many of these failures, but still calls a tool on only 55 of 309 tasks, covering 23.9% of tool-reachable tasks. On VLC, where 16 of 17 tasks are tool-reachable, it never calls a tool. An RL probe with a dense post-normalization bonus increases tool adoption by roughly an order of magnitude and survives greedy decoding, but held-out accuracy does not improve. This suggests the reward reaches the tool-choice policy but not tool competence. A context-level probe shows that the screenshot after a successful tool call is often redundant; retraining with the deployment-time observation rule yields a half-cost operating point without out-of-distribution accuracy loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read Sections 3.1–3.2 for conditional tool effectiveness and the adoption gap, Section 5.2 for the RL probe, and Sections 4.2/5.3 for screenshot compression after successful tool calls. The main lesson for foundation-model researchers is that inference-time tool injection does not by itself create reliable low-cost tool use. The missing piece is a training signal that teaches when and how the tool path should replace the visual path.

recommendation.zh: 工具使用的行为-能力分离是关键发现，直接修正后训练RL的设计思路，重点看§4的RL探针实验结果
recommendation.en: The behavior-competence disentanglement in tool use is a key finding that revises post-training RL design; focus on §4 RL probe results

paper.title: SeaSlides: Semantic Abstraction Layer for Agentic Slide Generation
paper.abstract: Agentic presentation generation must preserve source content, maintain coherent visual design, render specialized objects, and produce usable artifacts. Existing systems meet only part of this requirement: templates preserve regularity but restrict adaptation, whereas free-form HTML or SVG gives models flexibility at the cost of low-level rendering decisions. This mismatch makes long technical decks brittle, especially when slides contain formulas, code, or data graphics. We present SeaSlides, a

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent幻灯片生成方法存在模板灵活性不足、自由形式渲染易出错（尤其公式/代码/图表）的矛盾，难以生成高质量长技术演示文稿
summary.importance: 提出语义抽象层的通用设计思路（方法创新），分离内容创作与布局渲染，解决了灵活性与可靠性的平衡问题
summary.technical_approach: 构建SeaSlides框架，模型仅通过可复用组件与能力模块编写结构化内容，模板负责布局、样式与渲染；分别在HTML（模板DOM组件）与Typst（模板函数+包模块）中实例化，支持专业元素渲染
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型与训练细节，核心验证了语义抽象层在技术幻灯片生成中的内容保真度、设计一致性与专业元素渲染可靠性
summary.authors_note: 机构为Cohere，属于知名大模型厂商，专注于LLM与多模态模型研发

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic slide generation systems face a tradeoff between template inflexibility and error-prone free-form rendering (especially for formulas, code, charts) for long technical decks
summary_en.importance: Proposes a general semantic abstraction layer design (method innovation) that separates content authoring from layout rendering to balance flexibility and reliability
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds the SeaSlides framework where models author structured content only via reusable components and capability modules, while templates handle layout, style, and rendering; instantiated in HTML (template-defined DOM components) and Typst (template functions + package-backed modules) to support specialized element rendering
summary_en.experiments: No specific model or training details disclosed; core experiments validate content fidelity, design consistency, and specialized element rendering reliability of the semantic abstraction layer in technical slide generation
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with Cohere, a well-known large model vendor focusing on LLM and multimodal model R&D

recommendation.zh: 语义抽象层分离内容与渲染的思路可迁移到Agent工具接口设计，仅看§2的抽象层定义即可
recommendation.en: The semantic abstraction layer separating content and rendering can be transferred to agent tool interface design; only check §2 for abstraction layer definition

paper.title: Towards Robust Tool Use in Agents via Experience-Driven Adaptive Guidance
paper.abstract: The performance bottleneck of agents is increasingly shifting from model capability to the robustness of their execution processes. Tools play a central role as the primary interface through which agents interact with external environments, yet existing methods rarely focus on ensuring robust tool use across diverse runtime conditions. To address this problem, we propose ExpG, a mechanism that builds and refines adaptive guidance capturing each tool's capability boundaries and best practices, th

summary.core_problem: 智能体的工具调用在不同运行条件下不够鲁棒，现有方法较少刻画每个工具的能力边界与最佳实践。
summary.importance: 通用 Agent 工具使用的方法改进，核心是从历史轨迹中沉淀经验并生成自适应指导，但创新性偏增量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ExpG，分三阶段：从历史执行轨迹做多方面归因以获取结构化经验；通过过滤、等价类选择和摘要蒸馏经验池；将经验转化为可复用的自适应指导以提升工具调用鲁棒性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据、基线或量化提升，实验细节缺失。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent tool use is not robust across diverse runtime conditions, and existing methods rarely capture each tool's capability boundaries and best practices.
summary_en.importance: A method for improving general agent tool-use robustness by distilling experience from execution trajectories, though the contribution appears incremental.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExpG has three phases: experience acquisition via multi-aspect attribution on historical trajectories; experience distillation through filtering, equivalence-class selection, and summarization; and conversion of experience into adaptive guidance for tool use.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative improvements.

recommendation.zh: 工具调用鲁棒性的经验池方案，思路常规且摘要无实验；知道即可，暂不值得细读。
recommendation.en: A standard experience-pool approach to tool-use robustness with no experiments in the abstract; worth knowing about but not a close read.

paper.title: Know It, Act on It: Investigating Memory Utilization in LLM Personalization
paper.abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents evolve into personalized companions, memory has emerged as a core capability. However, LLMs face a knowledge utilization problem: they may fail to act on relevant user preferences even when they are fully present in context. When an agent fails to tailor its response in a context where previously shared user preferences should matter, it is unclear whether the model failed to remember that information or remembered it but failed to use it. To isolate this bre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要区分个性化 agent 的两类失败：模型到底是没有记住用户偏好，还是记住了但没有在相关场景中使用。它用同一条偏好同时做 Know test 和 Act test，避免只测召回或只测行为带来的诊断混淆。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 的启发在于：长上下文、RAG 或外部记忆并不自动等价于可用知识。模型需要把偏好从上下文或记忆中转化为行为约束，这涉及 instruction following、context utilization、偏好条件生成和安全敏感偏好的优先级处理。这个评测范式可以帮助区分检索失败、上下文呈现失败和模型执行失败，也能反过来指导记忆系统的数据格式、SFT 样本构造和偏好利用类 RL 目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 paired evaluation。对每个用户偏好，Know test 直接询问模型是否能回忆该偏好；Act test 给出一个自然任务场景，不显式提醒偏好，但正确响应需要使用它。偏好表达强度分为 explicit、incidental、inferential 三档，用来测试偏好从明确陈述到隐含推断时的利用难度。实验采用 incremental memory construction，让每个系统通过自己的原生记忆流水线处理信息，而不是把所有历史一次性塞进静态长上下文。评测对象覆盖 16 个系统、5 类记忆架构，包括纯长上下文模型和带专门记忆模块的 agent 框架。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 50 个 persona、1,000 条偏好和三种表达条件，共 3,000 个实例。主要结果是 Know 和 Act 之间存在稳定缺口：即使模型能回忆偏好，也经常不能把它转化为合适行为；表现最好的系统也只能把不超过三分之二的成功记忆偏好转化为正确行动。专门记忆系统能显著缩小缺口，例如 Mem0 将 GPT-4o-mini 的 utilization rate 从 16.3% 提升到 54.6%，而且提升更多体现在行为侧，不只是召回侧。不同偏好类型差异明显，health 和 therapy 相关偏好在利用率上最低，这类偏好的失败成本又更高。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 peanut allergy 例子和 Know/Act 解耦动机；实验设计部分看三档 preference expression、incremental memory construction、16 个系统和 5 类架构的设置；结果部分重点看 Know-Act gap、utilization rate 定义、Mem0 对 GPT-4o-mini 的提升，以及按偏好类型拆分的失败模式。若关注模型训练，可重点看 Act 失败案例，因为这些案例更接近 context utilization 和偏好条件生成的训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper separates two failure modes in personalized LLM agents: failing to remember a user preference and remembering it but failing to act on it. It evaluates the same preference with a paired Know test and Act test, which avoids the ambiguity of recall-only or behavior-only evaluation.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and post-training research is the distinction between accessible knowledge and usable knowledge. Long context, RAG, and external memory do not guarantee that a model will convert retrieved preferences into behavioral constraints. This matters for instruction following, context utilization, preference-conditioned generation, and safety-sensitive personalization. The setup can help diagnose whether failures come from retrieval, memory formatting, or the model’s inability to apply relevant context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation is built around paired tests. The Know test directly asks the agent to recall a specific preference. The Act test presents a natural scenario where the preference should affect the response, without explicitly mentioning that preference. Preferences are injected at three expression strengths: explicit, incidental, and inferential. The experiments use incremental memory construction so that each system processes information through its native memory pipeline, rather than receiving a static concatenated context. The benchmark covers 16 systems across five memory-architecture categories, including pure long-context systems and dedicated memory frameworks.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 50 personas, 1,000 preferences, and three expression conditions, producing 3,000 instances. The central result is a persistent Know-Act gap: even when agents can recall a preference, they often fail to use it in behavior. The strongest systems convert no more than two-thirds of successfully remembered preferences into appropriate actions. Memory systems reduce the gap; for example, Mem0 raises GPT-4o-mini’s utilization rate from 16.3% to 54.6%, with gains concentrated on behavioral use rather than recall alone. Utilization also varies by preference category, with health and therapy preferences among the weakest despite their higher practical risk.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivation and the allergy example, then read the paired Know/Act design, the three preference-expression levels, and the incremental memory-construction protocol. In the results, focus on the Know-Act gap, the definition of utilization rate, the Mem0 versus GPT-4o-mini comparison, and the category-level breakdown of failures. For training-oriented readers, the most useful part is the Act failure analysis, since it exposes cases where relevant context is present but not converted into response constraints.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你怎么训模型，但会纠正一个常见误判：很多“记忆差”其实是利用差；读评测协议和 gap 分析就够，适合拿来重做内部 memory eval。
recommendation.en: It will not teach you how to train models, but it fixes a common misread: much of “bad memory” is actually bad utilization; read the protocol and gap analysis, then adapt it for internal memory evals.

paper.title: From Scoring to Acting: Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recent work on LLM agents is shifting from external capability elicitation to capability internalization, enabling agents to retain useful skills without retrieval at inference time. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising direction, but many existing methods typically supervise students by scoring actions along student-generated trajectories. Such supervision has two limitations: teacher preferences are not validated by environment outcomes, and action-level scores underuse inform

summary.core_problem: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏方法对 Agent 任务中教师信号的利用存在两个缺陷：一是教师对单个动作的偏好打分未经环境最终结果验证，局部高分动作仍可能导致后续失败；二是动作级评分没有充分利用学生失败轨迹、教师成功轨迹以及二者行为分歧中的结构信息，尤其在长程任务中问题突出。
summary.importance: 对 post-train 阶段 Agent 能力内化的训练信号设计有参考价值。核心观察——失败轨迹之间存在可复用的有效前缀、教师干预点应自适应选择且必须经结果验证、师生轨迹的可比信息集中在首个分歧点——对自蒸馏和偏好学习的 credit assignment 有启发，但本质仍是 Agent 训练方法改进，不涉及预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OVCSD（Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation），包含三个设计：(1) 将学生失败轨迹组织成前缀树，从较深的共享状态开始尝试教师干预（保留学生已取得的有效进展），教师无法恢复时再逐步回溯到更早状态；(2) 教师从选定的学生状态开始执行，只有环境奖励确认任务完成的轨迹才被接受为监督信号，而非仅依赖教师动作评分；(3) 在教师成功轨迹与学生失败分支的首个状态对齐分歧点上做对比学习——提升验证过的教师动作概率、降低失败学生动作概率，分歧点之后的完成行为通过不同目标学习。
summary.experiments: 论文给出了三个核心观察的分析论证，但提供的全文在实验部分截断，未展示具体基准、参数量和数值结果。方法设计基于细粒度轨迹结构分析，在长程 Agent 任务（如网页导航、工具调用类环境）上验证的结论需要补充实验部分才能完整评估。
summary.reading_guide: 重点读 Introduction 和方法设计部分（第3节），关注失败轨迹前缀树构建、自适应干预点回溯策略、首个分歧点对比学习这三个机制的设计动机。实验部分未提供完整，预计泛读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing on-policy self-distillation methods for LLM agents suffer from two limitations in their use of teacher supervision: teacher action-level preferences are not validated by eventual environment outcomes (locally high-scored actions can still lead to failure), and action-level scoring underutilizes structural information in failed student rollouts, teacher rollouts, and the behavioral divergence between them—a problem that becomes acute in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: The work offers useful observations on training signal design for agent capability internalization during post-training. The key insights—that failed trajectories share reusable valid prefixes, teacher intervention points should be adaptive and outcome-verified, and comparable information between teacher and student concentrates at the first divergence state—are relevant to credit assignment in self-distillation and preference learning, though the method itself remains an agent training improvement rather than a pretraining contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: OVCSD (Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation) introduces three design choices: (1) Failed student trajectories are organized into a prefix tree; teacher intervention starts from deeper shared states to preserve valid student progress, backtracking to earlier states only when the teacher cannot recover. (2) The teacher acts from the selected student state, and only continuations verified successful by environment reward are accepted as supervision—replacing unverified teacher action scores. (3) Comparative learning is applied at the first state-aligned divergence between the successful teacher continuation and the failed student branch, increasing probability of the verified teacher action and decreasing probabilities of failed student alternatives; post-divergence completion behavior is learned through a separate objective.
summary_en.experiments: The paper presents analytical motivation for three core observations, but the provided text truncates before the experimental section, so specific benchmarks, model sizes, and numerical results are not available for evaluation. The method design is grounded in fine-grained trajectory structure analysis; full assessment requires the complete experimental results on long-horizon agent environments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction and method design (Section 3), particularly the motivation for the prefix-tree structure over failed trajectories, the adaptive intervention backtracking strategy, and the first-divergence comparative learning mechanism. The experimental section is incomplete in the provided text. Estimated skimming time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 结果验证+轨迹对比的组合修正了现有自蒸馏中监督信号不可靠的问题，对RL/蒸馏混合训练设计有参考，重点看§3.2前缀树状态复用部分。
recommendation.en: The combination of outcome verification and trajectory comparison fixes unreliable supervision in existing self-distillation; useful for RL-distillation hybrid design, focus on §3.2 prefix-tree state reuse.

paper.title: SkillSmith: Learning to Compose Parametric Skills and Textual Knowledge
paper.abstract: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) regularly feature two key mechanisms to autonomously solve complex problems: synthesizing text-based knowledge and procedures from past experiences and building parametric (weight-space) skill libraries for recurring sub-goals. To date, research has largely treated these as orthogonal pursuits: either organizing textual knowledge through composition and reflection, or consolidating parametric skills via weight-space merging. Consequently, th

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 系统里“文本知识库”和“参数化技能库”彼此割裂的问题，让模型能联合利用文字经验与可组合的权重技能来完成新任务。
summary.importance: 贡献更像 agent/continual skill composition 范式探索，而不是基座预训练本身；但它把模型权重当作可被语言模型读取和推理的另一种模态，这个设定对未来统一表示、参数外化和技能库设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSmith：用 prefix-tuning 作为参数化技能载体，把 prefix 权重与描述技能关系的文本一起喂给增强后的 LLM，让模型在推理时联合组合文本知识和 prefix 技能，面向目标能力进行 in-context 式技能合成与选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数值细节，但核心实验应围绕复杂任务中对文本记忆、经验反思与 prefix 技能库的联合使用，比较仅文本方法、仅权重合并方法以及联合方法的性能差异。由于只看到摘要，尚无法确认模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，阅读时需重点核对实验是否 clean、是否真正优于简单检索或 prefix ensemble。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Adhiguna Kuncoro、Arthur Szlam、Zohar Yahav 等，具备较强研究背景；摘要中的机构字段异常，无法仅据当前信息可靠确认机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the split between textual knowledge stores and parametric skill libraries in agent systems, aiming to let a model jointly use both for new tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an agent/continual skill-composition idea than a core pretraining paper, but the notion of treating model weights as another modality that an LM can read and reason over is conceptually interesting for unified representations and externalized skill libraries.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSmith uses prefix-tuning as the carrier of parametric skills, then augments an LLM to ingest both prefix weights and textual descriptions of skill relations. The model composes textual knowledge and prefix skills at inference time to target new capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full numerical details, but the key experiments likely compare text-only memory/reflection methods, weight-space skill methods, and the proposed joint approach on compositional agentic tasks. Since only the abstract is available, the main thing to verify is whether gains remain after controlling for simple retrieval or prefix ensembling baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Adhiguna Kuncoro, Arthur Szlam, and Zohar Yahav, suggesting a strong research pedigree; however, the institution field is malformed, so affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the headline result: treating prefix weights as a readable modality could matter for skill libraries, but first check whether it beats simple retrieval plus prefix selection.

paper.title: MagicSelector: Joint Optimization for Agent Tool Selection via Counterfactual Decomposition and Progressive Reranking
paper.abstract: We present MagicSelector, a joint optimization framework integrating Counterfactual task decomposition, Progressive reranking, and Dynamic Top-K, designed to address the fundamental challenges of tool retrieval in agents. MagicSelector is a specialized framework capable of translating ambiguous user instructions into executable atomic subtasks and guiding high-precision tool retrieval, effectively mitigating redundant noise and severe context distraction in out-of-domain (OOD) scenarios. We empo

summary.core_problem: Agent工具检索面临用户指令模糊、域外场景冗余噪声多、上下文干扰严重的问题。
summary.importance: 方法改进，将反事实推理与自蒸馏引入工具选择场景，提升工具检索的细粒度相关性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MagicSelector框架，包含三个模块：1）偏好引导的反事实任务分解，用反事实奖励量化分解对排序的边际因果增益；2）自蒸馏硬负样本驱动的渐进重排，同时优化点级与列表级相关性；3）动态Top-K自适应选择工具数量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未明确给出模型参数量、训练数据与基线细节，仅说明可缓解域外场景的噪声干扰问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent tool retrieval suffers from ambiguous user instructions, redundant noise in out-of-domain scenarios, and severe context distraction.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement: introduces counterfactual reasoning and self-distillation to tool selection, enhancing fine-grained relevance of tool retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MagicSelector with three modules: 1) preference-guided counterfactual task decomposition, using counterfactual reward to quantify marginal causal gain of decomposition on ranking; 2) progressive reranking driven by self-distillation hard negative mining, optimizing both point-wise and list-wise relevance; 3) dynamic Top-K to adaptively select tool count.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, or baseline details, only stating it mitigates noise and distraction in out-of-domain scenarios.

recommendation.zh: Agent工具选择的增量改进工作，反事实分解思路可参考，仅扫读方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on agent tool selection; the counterfactual decomposition idea is worth a quick skim of the methods section.

paper.title: A Control System, a Dataset, and a Recipe for Making Frozen LLM Agents Learn a Domain
paper.abstract: Production LLM agents are increasingly assembled from a frozen model wrapped in a harness: a prompt template, a tool set, a memory/retrieval layer, a planning strategy, and a verification policy. Two 2026 systems, Meta-Harness (Lee et al., 2026) and HyperAgents (Meta AI, 2026), show that this harness can itself be optimized or even self-rewritten by an agentic proposer -- at the cost of either an expensive code-search loop or unconstrained self-modifying code, neither of which is auditable or us

summary.core_problem: 生产环境中的LLM agent通常由冻结基座模型加外围harness（提示模板、工具集、记忆/检索层、规划策略、验证策略等）构成。现有harness优化方法要么需要昂贵的代码搜索循环，要么允许无约束的自修改代码，不可审计，也无法适配纯黑盒LLM API的部署场景。需要一种更受限、可审计、样本高效的在线harness配置优化方法，实现冻结LLM agent的领域适配。
summary.importance: harness配置对agent性能的影响可与基座模型本身相当，这一观察为理解基座模型能力如何通过外围系统释放提供了参考。用经典强化学习在离散harness空间上进行在线优化的思路，提供了一种无需微调模型的轻量领域适配路径，适用于冻结模型部署场景。其多目标奖励设计（准确率、验证分、合规性、无支撑声明、token成本、延迟）也为agent系统的优化目标设计提供了可参考的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 将agent harness拆解为6个离散控制杆：提示风格（direct/structured/reflective）、工具/检索策略（never/when_needed/always）、记忆策略（none/similar_successes/successes_and_failures）、规划策略（none/brief_plan/plan_and_revise）、验证策略（none/final_check/stepwise）、最大步数（2/4/6），共构成729种可能配置。基于DSPy构建组装器，根据选定配置生成对应的agent pipeline。采用两种经典样本高效强化学习算法进行在线优化：ε-greedy上下文bandit（线性价值估计，乐观初始化避免冷启动）和REINFORCE（softmax策略，线性特征logits，熵正则，移动平均基线）。奖励函数为多目标设计，包含成功分、验证分、合规分，扣除无支撑声明惩罚、token成本、延迟成本。对比基线包括随机搜索和DSPy-static（通过BootstrapFewShot优化的固定配置，为最强非自适应基线）。同时发布跨领域可验证任务数据集、训练过程完整轨迹与奖励分解日志，以及一份与模型提供商无关的部署手册。
summary.experiments: 目前公开内容中的实验细节不完整。已发布的数据集包含120个可验证任务（96训练/24测试，各领域均按80/20划分），覆盖三个领域：40个合成多工具CRM工作流（通过模拟后端的状态diff评分）、40个HumanEval编码问题（通过单元测试执行评分）、40个检索QA任务（通过精确匹配和token-F1评分）。实验在两个模型提供商的API上进行，对比两种在线RL控制器与随机搜索、DSPy-static基线的表现，核心验证可审计性、样本效率和多目标奖励下的性能，具体数值需参考完整论文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言部分的问题定义，以及与Meta-Harness、HyperAgents的对比，明确方法的定位。接着看第3章的harness拆解与控制空间设计，这是方法的核心框架。再了解奖励函数设计与强化学习算法的选择逻辑。数据集部分可快速浏览任务构成。预计阅读时间25-35分钟，完整实验部分需补充阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: Production LLM agents are typically built from a frozen base model wrapped in a harness (prompt template, tool set, memory/retrieval layer, planning strategy, verification policy, etc.). Existing harness optimization methods either require expensive code-search loops or allow unconstrained self-modifying code, making them unauditable and incompatible with fully black-box LLM API deployments. A more constrained, auditable, sample-efficient approach for online harness configuration optimization is needed for domain adaptation of frozen LLM agents.
summary_en.importance: The observation that harness configuration can have as much impact on agent performance as the underlying base model informs how base model capabilities are unlocked through peripheral systems. The approach of using classic reinforcement learning to optimize over a discrete harness space provides a lightweight domain adaptation path that requires no model fine-tuning, suitable for frozen model deployment scenarios. Its multi-objective reward design (accuracy, verifier score, compliance, unsupported claims, token cost, latency) also provides a reference framework for agent system optimization objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The agent harness is decomposed into six discrete levers: prompt style (direct/structured/reflective), tool/retrieval policy (never/when_needed/always), memory policy (none/similar_successes/successes_and_failures), planning policy (none/brief_plan/plan_and_revise), verification policy (none/final_check/stepwise), and max steps (2/4/6), forming a total of 729 possible configurations. A DSPy-based assembler constructs the corresponding agent pipeline from a selected configuration. Two classic sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithms are used for online optimization: an ε-greedy contextual bandit (with linear value estimation and optimistic initialization to avoid cold-start issues) and REINFORCE (with softmax policy, linear-in-features logits, entropy regularization, and a moving-average baseline). The reward function is multi-objective, combining success score, verifier score, and compliance score, with penalties for unsupported claims, token cost, and latency. Baselines include random search and DSPy-static (a fixed configuration optimized via BootstrapFewShot, the strongest non-adaptive baseline). A cross-domain verifiable task dataset, full training trajectory and reward decomposition logs, and a provider-agnostic deployment playbook are also released.
summary_en.experiments: Experimental details are incomplete in the currently available content. The released dataset contains 120 verifiable tasks (96 train / 24 held-out test, 80/20 split per domain) across three domains: 40 synthetic multi-tool CRM workflows (graded by state diff against a mock backend), 40 HumanEval coding problems (graded by unit test execution), and 40 retrieval QA tasks (graded by exact match and token-F1). Experiments are conducted on APIs from two model providers, comparing the performance of two online RL controllers against random search and the DSPy-static baseline, with a focus on auditability, sample efficiency, and multi-objective reward performance. Specific metrics require reference to the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skim reading, start with the Introduction for problem definition and comparison to Meta-Harness and HyperAgents to clarify the method's positioning. Next, read Section 3 on harness decomposition and control space design, which forms the core methodological framework. Then review the reward function design and RL algorithm selection logic. The dataset section can be skimmed for task composition. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes, with full experimental sections requiring supplementary reading.

recommendation.zh: Meta 做的冻结模型 harness 在线 RL 方案，对理解后训练时代基座与系统边界有启发，重点看奖励设计部分。
recommendation.en: Meta's online RL over a frozen-model harness illuminates the base-model vs. system boundary in the post-training era; focus on the reward design section.

paper.title: Speculate While You Reason: Teaching Agents to Predict Their Next Tool Call via Joint Agent-Speculator RL
paper.abstract: Large language model agents often spend substantial wall-clock time waiting for tool call results.
