summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated as PaperPilot-9B against a Qwen3.5-9B toolset agent in multi-turn interaction. The abstract reports improved Hit-related metrics over the base agent; exact dataset scale, number of turns, and margins are not fully available in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 只看 workflow induction 训练设计即可；任务偏垂直，但显式 DAG 比纯 CoT agent 更适合做可控工具策略。
recommendation.en: Skim only the workflow-induction training design; the task is vertical, but explicit DAGs are a cleaner control surface than pure CoT agents.

paper.title: AutoMem: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill
paper.abstract: Memory expertise is a learned skill: knowing what to encode, when to retrieve, and how to organize knowledge--a capacity known in cognitive science as metamemory. We bring this perspective to LLMs by treating memory management as a trainable skill. We promote file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, letting the model itself decide how to manage its memory. This memory skill improves along two axes: the structure that supports it (prompts, file schemas, action

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM Agent 的记忆管理依赖人工设计（记忆内容、检索时机、组织结构），长时序任务中记忆错误的影响具有滞后性，难以人工优化记忆结构与使用策略。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出将记忆管理作为可训练认知技能的视角，开发了自动优化记忆结构与使用熟练度的框架，为长时序 Agent 的记忆设计提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoMem 框架，将文件系统操作提升为与任务动作并列的一等记忆动作，由模型自主决定记忆管理方式；包含自动化循环：用强 LLM 审查完整 Agent 轨迹，迭代修订记忆结构（提示、文件模式、动作词汇），并优化模型的记忆使用熟练度。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，未给出完整实验设置与量化结果；方法针对长时序 Agent 任务，旨在自动化记忆结构与技能的优化过程。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学研究团队，Serena Yeung-Levy 为多模态与智能体领域知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent memory management relies on manual design (what to encode, when to retrieve, how to organize); in long-horizon tasks, memory errors have delayed effects, making manual optimization of memory structures and strategies difficult.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes the perspective of memory management as a trainable cognitive skill, and develops a framework for automatically optimizing memory structure and usage proficiency, offering new ideas for long-horizon agent memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces AutoMem, a framework that promotes file-system operations to first-class memory actions alongside task actions, letting the model decide how to manage its memory; it includes an automated loop where a strong LLM reviews full agent trajectories and iteratively revises memory structure (prompts, file schemas, action vocabulary) and improves the model's memory usage proficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, full experimental setup and quantitative results not provided; the method targets long-horizon agent tasks, aiming to automate memory structure and skill optimization.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University research team; Serena Yeung-Levy is a leading researcher in multimodal learning and intelligent agents.

recommendation.zh: 将记忆作为可训练技能的视角有启发性，自动迭代记忆结构的思路可用于长上下文 Agent 设计，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The perspective of memory as a trainable skill is inspiring; automated memory structure iteration is useful for long-context agent design, read abstract only.

paper.title: SkillSelect-Serve: Budget-Controllable and QoS-Aware Skill Service Recommendation and Composition for Small LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reusable skill libraries are becoming important infrastructure for large language model (LLM) agents, yet existing selection methods often treat skills as retrievable documents and return fixed top-k lists. This paper presents SkillSelect-Serve, a budget-controllable and QoS-aware framework that formulates agent skill selection as Skill Service Recommendation and Composition. SkillSelect-Serve represents raw skills as structured Skill Services with functional descriptions, dependencies, context

summary.core_problem: 解决小型 LLM Agent 在大规模技能库中选择和组合技能时，top-k 检索无法同时控制预算、覆盖度、依赖、风险和 QoS 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 技能服务化与组合策略。它不直接影响预训练，但对“小模型 + 外部技能库”的系统形态有参考价值，尤其是把 skill 从文本片段改造成带成本、风险、依赖和服务质量属性的可组合对象。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSelect-Serve，将原始技能表示为结构化 Skill Services，包含功能描述、依赖、上下文成本、风险和 QoS 属性。系统用本地 Micro-Agent Requirement Planner 将自然语言任务转成结构化需求，再通过共享发现模块召回候选技能，最后用双粒度效用建模估计单技能边际适配度，并在 bundle 层校准覆盖、冗余、成本和风险。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 35,353 个技能和 586 个任务查询。摘要说明该方法用于预算可控和 QoS-aware 的技能推荐与组合，但给出的文本被截断，无法确认完整 baseline、评价指标、模型配置和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses skill selection and composition for small LLM agents when simple top-k retrieval cannot jointly optimize budget, coverage, dependencies, risk, and QoS.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-system method for service-oriented skill libraries. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to the system pattern of small models augmented with external skills, especially the move from document-like skills to structured, composable service objects.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSelect-Serve represents raw skills as structured Skill Services with functional descriptions, dependencies, context cost, risk, and QoS attributes. A local Micro-Agent Requirement Planner converts natural-language tasks into structured requirements, a shared discovery backbone retrieves candidate services, and dual-granularity utility modeling estimates skill-level marginal suitability plus bundle-level trade-offs over coverage, redundancy, cost, and risk.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments involve 35,353 skills and 586 task queries. The abstract states that the framework supports budget-controllable and QoS-aware skill recommendation and composition, but the provided text is truncated, so the baselines, metrics, model setup, and gains cannot be verified from the prompt.

recommendation.zh: 只看技能服务表示和 bundle utility；它对小模型工具化有参考，但不是会改变训练策略的结果。
recommendation.en: Read only the skill-service representation and bundle utility model; it informs small-model tooling, not training strategy.

paper.title: UCOB: Learning to Utilize and Evolve Agentic Skills via Credit-Aware On-Policy Bidirectional Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Skill memories can improve agentic reinforcement learning by reusing past experience as textual guidance, but retrieved skills are not oracular: they may help in one state while misleading the same policy in another. This makes the common privileged-teacher assumption fragile, namely that a skill-conditioned prompt can be treated as a fixed teacher for the no-skill prompt. We introduce UCOB, a framework for learning to utilize and evolve agentic skills via credit-aware on-policy bidirectional se

summary.core_problem: 解决技能记忆在 agentic RL 中的“固定教师”问题：检索到的文字技能并不总是有用，同一个策略在同一类任务里，有技能 prompt 可能比无技能 prompt 更差。固定把 skill-conditioned 分支当教师，会把局部错误行为蒸馏进模型。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent 后训练和长程交互 RL 的训练机制。但它给 process-level 信号设计一个有用启发：外部记忆、反思文本、技能库不能天然视为高质量监督源，监督方向需要由局部 credit 决定，而不是由上下文形式决定。这对用合成轨迹、反思数据、工具日志做 SFT/RL 数据筛选也有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: UCOB 把有技能 prompt 和无技能 prompt 看成同一个在线模型的两个 on-policy context views，而不是预设 teacher/student。训练时混合采样 skill/no-skill rollouts，并按任务和 anchor state 分组。对每个局部状态组计算 return-to-go，比较 skill-conditioned 视角和 no-skill 视角的平均回报。回报更高的一侧成为当前局部教师，向另一侧做自蒸馏。这样，有用技能会被内化到无技能上下文里；误导性技能会被无技能分支纠正。论文还把同一个局部回报差用于更新任务级和状态级技能记忆、做 utility-aware retrieval，并训练反思式 skill writer，使策略学习和技能库演化闭环。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA 等长程交互任务。诊断实验显示，skill-conditioned 分支并不稳定优于 no-skill 分支；在 WebShop 上，有技能评估长期弱于无技能评估。把 skill-conditioned rollout 也纳入 on-policy RL 后，暴露偏移有所缓解，但仍不能保证有技能分支成为可靠教师。主实验中，UCOB 相比 skill-free RL、技能记忆基线和固定方向自蒸馏方法有更稳定收益。消融验证了局部 teacher routing、记忆演化、utility-aware retrieval 等模块的贡献。给定材料未提供完整表格数值，适合把结果解读为机制验证，而不是只看最终分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的诊断实验和 Figure 3/4，它们说明为什么“有技能就是教师”这个假设不稳。再看方法部分中 task-anchor grouping、return-to-go gap、bidirectional distillation loss，以及技能记忆如何被局部 credit 更新。实验部分重点看 ablation 和 teacher routing analysis，判断收益来自局部监督方向，还是来自额外 rollout 和技能库规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a fixed-teacher failure mode in skill-augmented agentic RL. Retrieved textual skills are not always helpful; a skill-conditioned prompt can improve one local state and hurt another. Treating the skill-conditioned branch as a privileged teacher can therefore distill locally wrong behavior into the base policy.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is moderate, since the work is mainly about agent post-training. The useful lesson is about training-signal quality: external memories, reflections, and skill texts should not be trusted just because they look like higher-level supervision. The direction of supervision should be assigned by local credit. This matters for SFT/RL pipelines that use synthetic trajectories, tool logs, or self-reflection traces as training data.
summary_en.technical_approach: UCOB treats skill-conditioned and no-skill prompts as two on-policy context views of the same model. It samples mixed rollouts, groups records by task and anchor state, and computes return-to-go for each view inside the same local group. The view with the higher local return becomes the teacher for the other view. Helpful skill-conditioned behavior is distilled into the no-skill context, while misleading skill-induced behavior is corrected by the no-skill branch. The same return gap is reused to update task-level and state-level skill memories, guide utility-aware retrieval, and train the reflection-based skill writer.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers long-horizon agent tasks including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA. Diagnostic results show that the skill-conditioned branch is not consistently better than the no-skill branch; on WebShop, skill-conditioned evaluation remains weaker throughout training. Making skill-conditioned rollouts on-policy reduces exposure mismatch but still does not make the skill view a reliable teacher. UCOB improves over skill-free RL, skill-memory baselines, and fixed-direction self-distillation variants. Ablations isolate the effects of local teacher routing, memory evolution, and utility-aware retrieval. The provided material does not expose all table-level numbers, so the main value is the training-mechanism evidence rather than a single headline score.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the diagnostics in Section 2 and Figures 3–4, since they motivate the rejection of a fixed privileged teacher. Then read the method details for task-anchor grouping, return-to-go gaps, bidirectional distillation, and credit-based memory updates. In the experiments, focus on ablations and teacher-routing analysis to separate the effect of local supervision direction from extra rollouts or larger skill memories.

recommendation.zh: 信用感知的局部教师选择思路对 RL 后训练中的蒸馏设计有参考，重点看 §3 的 return-to-go 对比机制。
recommendation.en: The credit-aware local teacher selection idea is informative for distillation design in RL post-training; focus on the return-to-go comparison mechanism in §3.

paper.title: Towards Reliable and Robust LLM Planning: Symbolic Feedback-Driven Iterative Self-Refinement Framework
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have attracted widespread attention from academia and industry, yet their deployment raises critical security concerns regarding robustness and reliability. Planning, a core component of intelligent behavior, remains challenging for LLMs, which often produce infeasible or incorrect solutions in long-horizon decision-making tasks due to inherent complexity. In this paper, we propose a symbolic feedback-driven iterative self-refinement framework to enhance the robustne

summary.core_problem: LLM 在长程规划任务中易生成不可行或错误方案，缺乏鲁棒性与可靠性的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出符号反馈驱动的迭代自修正框架，结合符号验证与自然语言映射提升规划鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach: 设计自然语言提示机制将逻辑符号映射为自然语言描述，构建符号验证器识别错误并转化为可解释修正指令，引入规划识别器推断目标可达性以辅助自修正。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集与量化提升幅度，仅说明面向长程决策规划任务进行验证。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所等机构，Daniel Zeng 长期从事智能决策与多智能体研究。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs often produce infeasible or incorrect solutions in long-horizon planning, lacking robustness and reliability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a symbolic feedback-driven iterative self-refinement framework that combines symbolic verification with natural-language grounding to improve planning robustness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces a prompting mechanism that maps logical symbols to natural-language descriptions, builds a symbolic verifier that detects errors and converts them into interpretable corrective instructions, and adds a plan recognizer to infer goal reachability.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not specify model scale, datasets, or quantitative gains; only reports validation on long-horizon decision-making planning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include researchers from CASIA; Daniel Zeng has long worked on intelligent decision-making and multi-agent systems.

recommendation.zh: 典型的提示工程+符号验证组合，无预训练侧改动，作为 agent 规划方法备查即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: A typical prompting + symbolic-verification recipe with no pretraining-side changes; useful only as a literature reference, no need to read the full paper.

institutions: Chinese Academy of Sciences Institute of Automation

paper.title: Agentic Publication Protocol: An Attempt to Modernize Scientific Publication
paper.abstract: Scientific publication is still organized primarily around static manuscripts, even though much of scientific progress depends on tacit know-how: how to run code, reproduce figures, interpret edge cases, choose useful follow-up directions, and avoid failed paths. Large language model agents create an opportunity to publish not only knowledge, but also operational know-how in a form that future readers and researchers can directly use. This paper outlines the Agentic Publication Protocol (APP), a

summary.core_problem: 现有科学出版以静态手稿为核心，无法传递代码复现、边缘案例处理、失败路径规避等隐性实践知识。
summary.importance: 学术出版形态的范式创新，首次提出基于LLM agent的可执行出版协议，将静态论文升级为可交互、可复现的研究资产包。
summary.technical_approach: 设计Agentic Publication Protocol（APP）轻量标准，以版本控制仓库为出版载体，通过AGENTS.md配置文件+可选技能模块定义论文代理，支持成果解释、结果复现、后续研究辅助等交互。
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露定量实验，仅描述了协议的设计原则、文件结构与支持的agent技能场景。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括斯坦福大学的Xiao-Liang Qi（祁晓亮），知名理论物理学家与AI交叉领域研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current scientific publishing centers on static manuscripts and cannot transmit tacit practical knowledge such as code reproduction, edge case handling, and failed path avoidance.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation in academic publishing form, first proposing an LLM-agent-based executable publication protocol that upgrades static papers into interactive, reproducible research asset packages.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs the lightweight Agentic Publication Protocol (APP) standard, uses a version-controlled repository as the publication carrier, and defines paper agents via AGENTS.md configuration files + optional skill modules to support result explanation, reproduction, and follow-up research assistance.
summary_en.experiments: No quantitative experiments are disclosed in the provided abstract; only the protocol's design principles, file structure, and supported agent skill scenarios are described.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Xiao-Liang Qi from Stanford University, a well-known theoretical physicist and AI cross-disciplinary researcher.

recommendation.zh: 作为学术成果发布的新形态参考即可，对预训练方法、数据、架构本身无直接贡献。
recommendation.en: Good to know as a new academic publishing format, no direct contribution to LLM pretraining methods, data, or architecture.

paper.title: SKILL-DISCO: Distilling and Compiling Agent Traces into Reusable Procedural Skills
paper.abstract: Agents often repeatedly solve similar task instances from scratch, leading to unnecessary reasoning cost and long execution traces. Prior work has explored workflow reuse and executable skill induction, but it remains unclear which task scenarios admit procedural skills and how the shared procedural structure should be represented across successful traces. We study this problem in FSM-defined scenarios, where successful traces can be viewed as paths in an unknown transition graph, and formulate

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 agent 如何从成功轨迹中抽取可复用的过程技能，避免每个相似任务都重新推理和执行一长串低层动作。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 agent 记忆与程序化技能学习，不是基座预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“经验复用”从自然语言总结推进到结构化控制流抽象：技能不是一段提示词或脚本，而是多个成功轨迹共享的参数化状态转移子图。这个方向与长期记忆、工具使用、agent continual learning、以及把强模型诱导出的程序知识迁移给小模型有关。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把适用范围限定在 FSM-defined scenarios，即有限状态、有限动作、确定性转移的环境。若完整转移图已知，任务可以化为图搜索；现实中转移图不可见，只能观察成功轨迹。Skill-DisCo 用 Parameterized Finite-State Machine 视角表示技能：先把具体状态和动作提升为带参数的状态与算子，再在多条成功轨迹中寻找高覆盖、紧凑、可绑定参数的控制流子图。随后进入 compilation 阶段，把这些结构编译成可调用、可执行、可验证的 procedural skills。相比直接让 LLM 从单条轨迹写技能，它更强调跨轨迹共享结构，减少库中碎片化和重复技能。
summary.experiments: 摘要和正文片段说明实验覆盖多个 benchmark 和不同模型规模，结果显示 Skill-DisCo 同时提升成功率和执行效率。分析还指出，编译后的紧凑技能库能降低冗余，提高执行可靠性，并支持用较强的 induction model 生成技能、再由较小的 execution model 调用技能。给出的材料中没有提供具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、成功率提升或 token/step 节省数字，因此不应过度外推。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看 Preliminaries 中 FSM-defined scenario、primitive operator、PFSM 的定义；再看 Skill-DisCo 的 distillation 和 compilation 流程。若只关心 agent 训练信号和经验复用，可优先看技能发现目标如何避免 trace-specific routine，以及验证机制如何把自然语言轨迹变成可执行单元。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how an agent can distill reusable procedural skills from successful trajectories, instead of repeatedly solving similar task instances from scratch with long reasoning and action traces.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent skill-learning paper, not a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its useful signal for pretraining-adjacent research is the structured view of experience reuse. Skills are treated as parameterized control-flow subgraphs shared across successful traces, rather than textual summaries or one-off scripts. That connects to agent continual learning, long-term memory, tool-use abstraction, and transferring procedural knowledge induced by stronger models to smaller execution models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The scope is explicitly limited to FSM-defined scenarios with finite states, finite actions, and deterministic transitions. If the full transition graph were known, task solving would reduce to graph search; in the agent setting, only successful traces are observed. Skill-DisCo approximates this missing graph structure through a Parameterized Finite-State Machine view. It lifts concrete states and actions into parameterized states and operators, searches for compact high-coverage control-flow subgraphs across traces, and then compiles these discoveries into callable, executable, and verifiable procedural skills. The key distinction from direct LLM-based skill synthesis is that the discovery target is shared transition structure, not a surface-level routine extracted from a single trace.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports experiments across multiple benchmarks and model scales. The claimed effects are improved success rate and efficiency, reduced skill-library redundancy, more reliable execution, and transfer from stronger induction models to smaller execution models. The available content does not include concrete benchmark names, model sizes, success-rate deltas, or step/token reduction numbers, so the result should be read as a qualitative summary unless the experimental section is checked directly.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take 30–45 minutes. Read the definitions of FSM-defined scenarios, primitive operators, and PFSMs, then inspect the distillation and compilation pipeline. For readers interested in agent training signals, the most relevant parts are how the method avoids trace-specific routines and how verification turns induced procedural patterns into executable units.

recommendation.zh: 这篇可 skim：§方法里的 PFSM 表示比结果更有用，适合拿来想 agent 轨迹如何变成训练资产。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim: the PFSM representation is more useful than the benchmark gains, especially for turning agent traces into training assets.

paper.title: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Process reward models enable fine-grained, step-level evaluation of LLMs, yet building them for agentic settings remains prohibitively difficult: long-horizon interactions, irreversible actions, and stochastic environment feedback make both human annotation and Monte Carlo estimation infeasible at scale. In this work, we show that reinforcement learning (RL) post-training already provides the ingredients for effective step-level scoring, eliminating the need for dedicated reward model training a

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：如何在长程、随机、带外部环境反馈的 LLM agent 任务中，获得可靠的 step-level 过程评分，而不额外训练 PRM。传统 PRM 在数学题中还能依赖人工标注、回溯、Monte Carlo rollout；但 agent 环境里动作可能不可逆，状态由历史 token、工具调用和环境反馈共同决定，重复采样成本高且分布不稳定。该论文要解决的不是再造一个奖励模型，而是从 RL post-training 已经产生的策略变化中提取过程信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-training 接口有直接启发。它把 RL 后训练产生的 policy shift 解释为可复用的过程级优势信号，说明 post-training checkpoint pair 不只是产物，也可以作为评估器和推理时控制信号。贡献量级主要在方法范式：不依赖新标注、不训练专门 PRM，只需要 RL policy 与 reference policy 的 log-prob ratio。对基座研究员的价值在于，它给出了一个观察 RL 训练动态的新窗口：哪些 token/action 在 RL 后被显著上调，可能对应模型认为更接近任务进展的局部决策。这类信号也可反过来用于数据筛选、agent 轨迹诊断、RL 信号质量分析和持续训练监控。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 progress advantage：对同一状态和动作，计算 RL-trained policy 与 reference policy 的对数概率比，即 log π_RL(a_t|s_t) - log π_ref(a_t|s_t)。论文把 agent 过程形式化为一般随机 MDP，状态包含截至当前的完整 token 历史和环境观测，动作可细到 token，也可聚合到工具调用或 agent step。关键理论结果是，在带参考策略约束的 RL 目标下，最优策略相对于 reference policy 的 log-ratio 对应最优 advantage function；如果有 KL 系数，通常只差一个尺度因子。这个推导比以往 deterministic reasoning 场景里的 implicit PRM 更一般，因为 agent 的转移包含随机环境和外部交互，不能把完整输出看成静态字符串来打分。论文还讨论了它为何可覆盖主流 RL 算法，包括显式 KL 正则的 GRPO，以及主要依赖 clipping surrogate 的 DAPO。实现上不需要训练 reward model，只要能对候选轨迹在两个 checkpoint 上重算 log-prob，并按 token span、action 或 trajectory 聚合即可。这个设计的取舍很清楚：它牺牲了一个独立奖励模型的可解释边界，换来低成本、跨任务、与实际 RL 训练目标一致的过程信号。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个推理时用途：best-of-N 轨迹选择、成功/失败不确定性估计、失败步骤定位。基准包括 BFCLv4-MT、WebShop、AgentDojo、τ²-bench 和 Who & When；模型族包括 Gemma4、Qwen3.5、Qwen3 和 Olmo3。结果结论比较一致：在 test-time scaling 中，用 progress advantage 给 N 条候选轨迹排序，可以提高任务成功率，并优于 confidence-based scoring、预训练 reward model，以及若干任务特定 PRM；在 uncertainty quantification 中，用轨迹级聚合分数预测成功/失败，AUROC 高于预训练 PRM 和 proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge；在 failure attribution 中，它能定位多 agent 交互里的错误步骤，接近专门为该任务训练的方法。已给出的全文片段没有展开具体表格数值；精读时需要核对 Sec. 4.2、4.3、4.4 中每个 benchmark 的 success rate、AUROC、step accuracy，以及不同聚合策略和 checkpoint 选择的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读理论推导和实验消融。第一处重点是 MDP 形式化和 Proposition 1：看清 log-prob ratio 为什么对应 advantage，而不是普通 reward 或 value。尤其要注意尺度项、KL 正则项、reference policy 的角色，以及随机环境下条件状态如何定义。第二处重点是 Proposition 2：它解释了为什么该信号不只适用于显式 KL RL，也能用于 clipping 类算法。第三处重点是 Sec. 4.2-4.4：分别对应轨迹选择、失败预测和错误定位，建议直接看表格和每个 baseline 的定义，判断提升来自更好的过程信号，还是来自 policy/reference 的分布匹配优势。第四处重点是分析章节：应关注 token-level 到 action-level 的聚合方式、不同 RL checkpoint pair 的影响、reference 选择、长度偏置校正，以及对 reward hacking 的敏感性。值得深挖的问题是：如果 RL reward 本身有偏，progress advantage 会稳定放大哪些偏差；如果用于持续预训练或 mid-training 轨迹筛选，是否会造成过早收缩探索空间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical gap in agent training and evaluation: obtaining step-level process scores for long-horizon LLM agents without collecting process annotations or training a dedicated PRM. Standard PRM construction works better in settings such as math reasoning, where rollouts and human step labels are feasible. Agentic environments are harder: actions may be irreversible, transitions are stochastic, tool feedback changes the state, and Monte Carlo estimation becomes expensive or invalid.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a new use of the post-training artifact itself. The policy shift induced by RL is treated as a reusable process-level signal, not merely as a better policy. This matters for pretraining and post-training research because it exposes a measurable interface between the reference model, the RL-trained model, and downstream agent behavior. It can be used for test-time selection, trajectory filtering, training-signal auditing, and analysis of where RL changes the model’s local preferences. The contribution is methodological rather than data-scale driven: it avoids additional reward-model training and relies only on log probabilities from an RL checkpoint pair.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score, progress advantage, is the log-probability ratio between the RL-trained policy and its reference policy for the same action under the same state: log π_RL(a_t|s_t) - log π_ref(a_t|s_t). The paper formulates multi-turn agent interaction as a stochastic token-level MDP, where the state contains the full history of generated tokens, observed tokens, tool outputs, and environment feedback. Under a reference-regularized RL objective, the optimal policy ratio recovers the optimal advantage function up to the expected scaling from the regularization coefficient. This extends earlier implicit-reward interpretations beyond deterministic reasoning traces, because the conditioning state now includes stochastic environment transitions. The method can be applied at token, action, or trajectory level by aggregating token log-ratios. It is also argued to apply to common RL procedures, including explicitly KL-regularized algorithms such as GRPO and clipping-based algorithms such as DAPO. The design choice is pragmatic: use the actual policy movement produced by RL instead of fitting a separate process reward model that may not transfer across environments.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers three inference-time applications: best-of-N trajectory selection, success/failure uncertainty prediction, and failure-step attribution. Benchmarks include BFCLv4-MT, WebShop, AgentDojo, τ²-bench, and Who & When. Model families include Gemma4, Qwen3.5, Qwen3, and Olmo3. The reported pattern is consistent: progress advantage improves best-of-N task success over confidence-based scoring, pretrained reward models, and even some task-specific PRMs; it achieves higher AUROC for trajectory success prediction than pretrained PRMs and a proprietary LLM-as-a-Judge baseline; and it localizes failure steps in multi-agent settings with accuracy close to a method trained specifically for that task. The supplied full-text excerpt does not expose the numerical tables, so the exact success-rate gains, AUROC values, and step-accuracy numbers should be read directly from Sections 4.2 to 4.4.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the theory before the benchmark tables. The key part is the derivation around Proposition 1: it clarifies why a policy log-ratio should be interpreted as an advantage rather than as a raw reward. Pay attention to the role of the reference policy, the KL or trust-region scale, and the definition of state in a stochastic environment. Proposition 2 is the next important piece, since it explains the connection to practical RL algorithms beyond a clean KL-regularized objective. In the experiments, focus on the baseline definitions and aggregation rules: token-to-action aggregation, trajectory scoring, length normalization, and checkpoint-pair choice are likely to determine practical reliability. The most useful follow-up questions are about bias: a flawed RL reward can make progress advantage a faithful signal of the wrong training objective, so its use in data selection or continual training should be coupled with reward-quality diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻Agent RL后训练需额外训PRM的默认流程，§3的推导与信号构造应立刻在内部推理/Agent任务中复现验证
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the default process of requiring additional PRM training for agent RL post-training, the derivation and signal construction in §3 should be immediately reproduced and validated in internal reasoning/agent tasks

paper.title: Why Multi-Step Tool-Use Reinforcement Learning Collapses and How Supervisory Signals Fix It
paper.abstract: Tool use enables large language models (LLMs) to perform complex tasks, and recent agentic reinforcement learning (RL) methods show promise for enhancing model capabilities. However, RL alone often leads to instability or limited gains in tool-use tasks. In our experiments, some models exhibit catastrophic collapse, where performance abruptly drops and tool-invocation structures fail. The analysis reveals that these failures stem from unexpected probability spikes in specific control tokens, dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是多步 tool-use 场景下，为什么纯 RL 训练会突然失稳，甚至把一个原本会调用工具的模型训到几乎不可用。全文给出的结论很明确：主要问题不是能力退化，也不是推理链被彻底破坏，而是结构性崩塌。模型在 RL 过程中会把概率质量异常集中到少数控制 token 或格式 token 上，导致工具调用语法、turn 结构和执行协议被破坏；一旦结构坏掉，环境反馈也随之失真，训练进一步恶化。也就是说，模型“会做事”的能力还在，但“按正确协议把事做出来”的行为层被 RL 放大偏了。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义不在于 tool-use 本身，而在于它揭示了一个更一般的现象：当训练目标只给稀疏标量奖励，而生成过程又依赖严格结构时，优化会优先利用最容易被放大的局部 token 模式，而不是稳健地提升整体策略。这和长链推理、代码格式、XML/JSON 约束生成、函数调用协议都有直接关系。论文的贡献主要有两层。第一层是诊断层面：把 agentic RL 的失败从“RL 不会教会模型用工具”改写成“RL 会把结构 token 学坏”。第二层是方法层面：系统比较多种监督信号如何与 RL 结合，并指出简单混训不够，监督必须以合适的时序和形式介入，才能稳定结构而不过度牺牲泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法部分分成两块：失稳机理分析，以及监督信号设计。

机理分析上，作者把多轮 tool trajectory 写成 action-feedback 序列，关注 RL 训练中 token 分布如何演化。核心观察是，崩塌前往往先出现特定控制 token 的概率尖峰，随后合法工具调用格式迅速下降，错误响应频率陡增。作者进一步说明，这不是能力真正消失，因为在改变提示或放宽格式约束后，模型仍能表现出部分正确的工具使用与推理能力。问题出在 policy mass 被重新分配到少数“结构支点 token”上，生成被这些 token 牵引到退化模式。

在稳定化方案上，作者系统考察了六类 supervisory signals，并按训练组织方式分成 synchronous 和 interleaved 两大类。文中反复强调两者差别：synchronous 是在同一优化阶段把 RL 与监督目标一起混合；interleaved 则是在训练时间轴上交替进行 RL 和 SFT/监督更新。作者发现前者容易出现分布错配，因为监督样本和当前 RL rollout 的状态分布不一致，梯度会互相拉扯；后者更像周期性地把策略拉回到合法结构流形上，因此更稳。

具体监督形式包括：1）SFT 后接 RL，作为强初始化；2）off-policy supervision，用高质量轨迹直接监督当前策略；3）错误轨迹监督，把失败样本也纳入训练；4）hint-based guidance，在生成前提供正确提示或中间线索，但优化时去掉 hint，等于用 hint 只做行为引导、不让模型依赖显式提示；5）process reflection supervision，从训练过程中的中间推理步骤抽取反思文本，总结每一步的优缺点，再与原始错误轨迹配对构造 SFT 数据。这里最有意思的是最后两项，它们不是单纯喂正确答案，而是在结构失稳前给模型更细粒度的过程约束，弥补标量 reward 无法表达“这一轮格式对不对、调用位置对不对”的缺陷。

从与已有方法的区别看，很多 agentic RL 工作把重点放在 reward 设计、轨迹采样或环境搭建上；这篇文章更关心 token-level control dynamics，认为稳定性首先是一个生成结构控制问题，而不是单纯 credit assignment 问题。这一点很像把 RL 训练中的 failure mode 从高层策略失败，下沉到序列建模层面的局部概率异常。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的重点不是追求单点最好成绩，而是展示崩塌现象、比较监督方式、分析稳定性与泛化的取舍。全文明确提到在两类模型家族上做了系统实验，并比较了六种监督配置。虽然给到的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但几个结论是清楚的。

第一，纯 RL 会出现灾难性 collapse。表现为某一阶段后任务成功率接近归零，同时合法 tool-invocation 结构明显损坏，错误响应频率突然上升。这个“突然”很关键，说明不是平滑退化，而是训练动力学跨过某个阈值后的相变式失稳。

第二，SFT 初始化显著改善早期稳定性。也就是先把模型放到一个会按协议调用工具的区域，再做 RL，能明显降低一开始就跑偏的概率。但作者也指出，单靠 SFT 初始化并不能解决全部问题，尤其在更难的 OOD 设置下，可能出现泛化受限。

第三，简单同步混合监督与 RL 效果有限，甚至会因 distribution mismatch 带来问题。相比之下，interleaved training 更稳定，最终性能也更可靠。这个结论很重要，因为它说明“有没有监督”不是唯一变量，“监督在什么时候、以什么节奏进入训练”同样决定结果。

第四，process reflection supervision 能进一步提升稳定性和最终表现。原因不是它提供了更多标签，而是它把错误轨迹转成了可学习的过程文本，让模型知道哪一步出了问题、为什么错，而不是只看到一个终局 reward。

第五，作者专门分析了学习率敏感性和跨设置迁移。结论是稳定方法通常对学习率更不敏感，且在 format-level 和 content-level OOD 上更稳；但某些强监督方案虽然能保结构，却可能在 OOD 上掉点，说明结构约束和开放泛化之间存在张力。

如果精读全文，建议重点看展示 collapse 曲线、控制 token 概率演化、合法格式比例变化的图。这些图比最终平均分更能说明问题。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“现象—机理—干预”顺序读。

先看 Introduction 和展示 collapse 的主图，确认作者到底把什么定义为 failure。这里不要只看任务分数，要同时看 malformed tool call、错误响应频率、控制 token 概率变化。

然后看分析部分，重点理解作者为何说能力没有消失而是被结构失稳遮蔽。若文中有案例分析或替代提示实验，这部分值得细读，因为它决定了后续方法设计的方向：如果真是能力退化，就该改 reward 或探索；如果是结构崩塌，就该加行为约束。

接着看 supervisory signals 的分类和训练范式对比。尤其要分清 synchronous 与 interleaved 的差别，以及 hint-based guidance、process reflection supervision 各自解决什么问题。这里建议连同训练时间轴示意图一起看。

最后看 OOD、learning rate 和 transfer 分析。泛读时容易只记住“加监督更稳”，但真正有用的信息是：哪些监督主要修结构，哪些会牺牲泛化，哪些对超参更鲁棒。预计 35–50 分钟能抓住主线；如果要把方法迁移到代码 agent、函数调用或长链推理训练，建议把实验和附录里的失败案例一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why pure RL often becomes unstable in multi-step tool-use training, sometimes driving a previously competent tool-using model to near-zero performance. The central claim is precise: the main failure is not loss of reasoning ability, but structural collapse. During RL, probability mass gets disproportionately amplified on a small set of control or formatting tokens, which breaks tool-call syntax, turn structure, and execution protocol. Once the structure is corrupted, environment feedback also becomes less meaningful, and training deteriorates further. In other words, the model may still know what to do, but RL distorts how that competence is serialized into valid agent trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining and foundation-model research goes beyond tool use. It exposes a broader optimization pathology: when the objective provides sparse scalar rewards but successful behavior depends on strict structured generation, training may exploit fragile local token patterns before it improves the full policy. That observation matters for function calling, code generation with syntax constraints, XML/JSON outputs, and long-horizon reasoning traces. The contribution is twofold. First, it reframes agentic RL failure from a capability-learning problem into a structural-control problem. Second, it systematically studies how different supervisory signals interact with RL, showing that supervision is not just an auxiliary boost; when scheduled properly, it acts as a stabilizer for structured generation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical story has two parts: diagnosing the collapse mechanism and designing supervisory interventions.

On the diagnosis side, the paper models multi-turn tool-use trajectories as alternating action-feedback sequences and tracks how token distributions evolve under RL. The key empirical pattern is that collapse is preceded by sharp probability spikes on specific control tokens, followed by a rapid drop in valid tool-invocation structure and a surge in malformed responses. The authors argue that this is not true capability erasure: under altered prompts or relaxed formatting conditions, the model can still display parts of the underlying reasoning and tool-use competence. The issue is that policy mass is being reallocated toward a few structural anchor tokens, pulling generation into degenerate execution modes.

On the intervention side, the paper studies six supervisory configurations, organized into two training paradigms: synchronous and interleaved. This distinction is one of the main practical insights. In synchronous training, RL and supervision are mixed within the same optimization phase. In interleaved training, RL updates and supervised updates alternate over time. The paper argues that synchronous mixing often suffers from distribution mismatch, because supervised trajectories and current RL rollouts come from different state distributions, leading to conflicting gradients. Interleaving instead acts like a periodic projection back onto a manifold of valid structured behavior, which is why it is more stable.

The supervisory forms include: (1) SFT followed by RL as a strong initialization; (2) off-policy supervision using high-quality trajectories; (3) supervision on erroneous trajectories; (4) hint-based guidance, where correct hints are prepended before generation but removed during optimization, so hints guide behavior without becoming a crutch; and (5) Process Reflection Supervision, where intermediate reasoning steps are converted into reflective textual supervision summarizing what each step did well or poorly, then paired with error trajectories to build SFT data. The last two are especially interesting because they do not merely provide correct outputs; they inject process-level constraints that scalar rewards cannot express, such as whether a tool was invoked in the right place or whether the trajectory remained structurally valid.

Relative to prior agentic RL work, which often emphasizes reward design, trajectory synthesis, or environment construction, this paper focuses on token-level control dynamics. Its main claim is that instability is first a sequence-modeling and structural-generation problem, not only a high-level credit-assignment problem.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are designed more to characterize failure modes and stabilization trade-offs than to chase a single best benchmark number. The paper reports systematic studies on two model families and compares six supervisory configurations. Even from the provided full-text excerpt, several findings are clear.

First, pure RL can undergo catastrophic collapse. Performance drops abruptly to near zero, valid tool-invocation structures break down, and malformed responses spike. The abruptness matters: this is not smooth degradation but threshold-like instability in training dynamics.

Second, SFT initialization substantially improves early-stage stability. Starting RL from a model already located in a region of valid tool-use behavior reduces the chance of immediate drift. At the same time, the paper notes that SFT alone is not enough, especially under harder OOD settings where generalization can remain limited.

Third, simply mixing supervision with RL in a synchronous way is often insufficient and can even hurt due to distribution mismatch. Interleaved training is consistently more stable and usually yields more reliable final performance. This is one of the strongest practical takeaways: the timing and scheduling of supervision matter as much as its presence.

Fourth, Process Reflection Supervision further improves both stability and final performance. Its advantage is not just more labels, but richer process-level learning signals extracted from failures, allowing the model to learn why a step was wrong rather than only receiving a terminal reward.

Fifth, the paper analyzes learning-rate sensitivity and cross-setting transfer. More stable methods tend to be less sensitive to learning rate and more robust under format-level and content-level OOD evaluation. However, some stronger supervision schemes preserve structure at the cost of OOD generalization, indicating a real tension between structural regularization and open-ended adaptability.

When reading the results, the most informative figures are likely those showing collapse trajectories, control-token probability evolution, and valid-format ratios over training, rather than only aggregate task scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order of phenomenon, mechanism, then intervention.

Start with the introduction and the main collapse figures. Do not focus only on task success rate; also track malformed tool calls, error-response frequency, and the probability trajectories of control tokens.

Then move to the analysis section and understand why the authors claim the capability is preserved but hidden by structural failure. If the paper includes prompt-variation or format-relaxation case studies, those are worth close reading because they determine the right remedy. If the issue were capability loss, one would redesign rewards or exploration. If it is structural collapse, one needs behavioral constraints.

Next, study the taxonomy of supervisory signals and the comparison between synchronous and interleaved training. Pay particular attention to what hint-based guidance and Process Reflection Supervision are each fixing. Training-timeline diagrams, if present, are likely useful here.

Finish with the OOD, learning-rate, and transfer analyses. The easy takeaway is “supervision stabilizes RL,” but the useful takeaway is finer-grained: which supervision mainly repairs structure, which harms generalization, and which is more hyperparameter-robust. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you want to adapt the ideas to code agents, function calling, or long-chain reasoning, also read the failure cases and appendix details.

paper.title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
paper.abstract: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain impro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：如何把更强的推理时计算转化成更高质量的训练数据和评测数据，而不是只用固定 prompt 做 Self-Instruct 式生成。核心目标不是生成更多样本，而是让一个 agent 像数据科学家一样创建、检查、迭代数据，并进一步学习如何更好地创建数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练数据研究的启发在于，它把合成数据生成从一次性 prompting 推向了闭环优化。数据不再只是模型采样的副产物，而是由 challenger、solver、verifier 和主控 agent 共同塑形的对象。这个方向适合用于构造推理训练数据、困难负例、benchmark 样本，以及 SFT/RL 的训练集。需要注意的是，当前贡献更偏方法框架和实践范式，离大规模预训练数据配比或数据质量定律还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: Autodata 的基本结构包含两个循环。内层循环由数据创建和数据分析组成：agent 基于 grounding context 生成样本，再检查样本是否正确、是否足够困难、是否能区分弱模型和强模型，然后把分析结果反馈给下一轮生成。外层循环是对这个“数据科学家 agent”本身做 meta-optimization，即优化 agent harness、prompt、工具使用和决策策略，使它更擅长产生有效数据。具体实现 Agentic Self-Instruct 使用四类子 agent：Challenger 生成样本，Weak solver 尝试解题，Strong solver 提供较强解答，Verifier/judge 检查答案和样本质量。对于可验证任务，可以要求强模型多数投票正确、弱模型多数投票错误；对于不可完全验证任务，则用 judge 根据 rubric 估计强弱解答的质量差距。相比传统 Self-Instruct，它显式把“难度控制”和“样本质量检查”放进生成流程，而不是先生成再简单过滤。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖计算机科学研究任务、法律推理任务、数学对象推理任务。结果显示，Agentic Self-Instruct 相比经典合成数据创建方法带来更好的训练或评测效果；进一步对数据科学家 agent 做 meta-optimization 后，提升更明显。文中提供的内容强调了弱/强 solver 间隔、verifier 反馈和多轮迭代的重要性，但当前给出的全文片段没有暴露完整表格中的逐任务数字、样本规模和提升幅度，因此不宜补写具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Autodata 总体框架图和 Agentic Self-Instruct 的实现图，理解它如何把 challenger、weak solver、strong solver、verifier 组织成数据创建闭环。实验部分主要看三个问题：一是它相对普通 Self-Instruct 的增益是否来自样本难度而非样本数量；二是 verifier 的可靠性如何影响数据质量；三是 meta-optimization 优化的是哪些 agent 决策。若关注预训练数据，值得深挖的是 support/coverage、difficulty 和 verifier noise 这些因素未来能否形成可测的数据质量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert additional inference-time compute into better training and evaluation data, rather than relying on one-shot Self-Instruct-style prompting. The target is not merely to generate more examples, but to build an agentic data scientist that creates, audits, and iterates on data, and can itself be meta-optimized.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training data work is the shift from static synthetic data generation to a closed-loop data construction process. Synthetic data is treated as an object to be shaped by a challenger, solvers, a verifier, and a controller, rather than as raw model samples followed by light filtering. This is most directly useful for reasoning data, hard negatives, benchmark construction, and SFT/RL data generation. The contribution is currently closer to a practical framework than to a scaling law or a large-scale pretraining data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autodata has an inner loop and an outer loop. The inner loop alternates between data creation and data analysis: an agent grounds on source material, generates examples, checks whether they are correct and challenging, measures whether they separate weak and strong models, and feeds the lessons back into the next generation pass. The outer loop meta-optimizes the data scientist agent itself, including its harness, prompts, tool use, and decision policy. The concrete implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct, uses a main orchestrator and four LLM-based subagents: a Challenger that creates examples, a Weak solver expected to fail on many generated cases, a Strong solver expected to solve them, and a Verifier/judge that evaluates both solutions and example quality. For verifiable tasks, the intended criterion is often that the strong solver majority is correct while the weak solver majority is wrong. For less verifiable tasks, the judge scores the gap using generated rubrics. Compared with standard Self-Instruct, the key addition is explicit difficulty control and iterative quality analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover computer science research tasks, legal reasoning, and reasoning over mathematical objects. Agentic Self-Instruct improves over classical synthetic dataset creation baselines, and meta-optimizing the data scientist agent provides an additional gain. The supplied full-content excerpt describes the setup and qualitative findings, but does not expose the complete per-task tables, dataset sizes, or exact improvement numbers, so the safe reading is about mechanism and design rather than precise effect size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the Autodata template and the Agentic Self-Instruct diagram, especially how the challenger, weak solver, strong solver, and verifier form a feedback loop. In the experiments, check whether gains come from harder examples rather than just more examples, how verifier errors are controlled, and what exactly is optimized during meta-optimization. For pretraining-data researchers, the useful thread is whether coverage, difficulty, solver gap, and verifier noise can become measurable data-quality signals.

recommendation.zh: 把合成数据流程改成可元优化的智能体闭环思路有参考价值，目前实验仅覆盖后训练推理任务，看§3方法和§4.2消融即可
recommendation.en: The meta-optimizable agent loop for synthetic data is a useful reference; experiments only cover post-training reasoning tasks, read §3 method and §4.2 ablation only

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
paper.abstract: Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary ov

summary.core_problem: 论文关注开放式、多步 persuasion agent 中的误差累积问题，尤其是早期检索或策略选择失误如何在长轨迹中放大并导致问题漂移与迎合。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 系统方法，不是基座预训练工作。价值在于它指出语义检索在主观任务中会把“主题相似”误当成“策略可迁移”，对做 agent memory/RAG 的研究员有参考意义，但对 pretrain 的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将标准 RAG 的失败归因于 semantic leakage：检索器按词汇/语义相似度取回内容，混入了与当前任务无关但表面相似的主题信息。为此提出 Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG)，通过离散类别瓶颈先把策略映射到 taxonomy，再按类别路由检索，以解耦论证结构与主题内容，减少长程轨迹中的污染传播。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 zero-shot、cross-domain 设定下，TS-RAG 相比标准语义检索能更好迁移抽象逻辑，并在不对称部署中帮助轻量模型借助重模型生成的策略库。未见模型参数、数据规模和量化提升幅度，说明更像系统概念验证而非大规模严谨 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies compounding failures in open-ended, multi-step persuasion agents, where early retrieval or strategy errors amplify over long trajectories and lead to drift and sycophancy.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining work. Its main value is the observation that semantic retrieval can confuse topical similarity with strategic transferability in subjective tasks. Useful for agent memory/RAG work, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute failures of standard RAG to semantic leakage: retrieval based on lexical/semantic overlap pulls in topically similar but strategically irrelevant content. They propose Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), which inserts a discrete categorical bottleneck by mapping strategies into a taxonomy and routing retrieval through that taxonomy, decoupling argumentative structure from topical content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims zero-shot cross-domain gains over standard semantic retrieval, especially for transferring abstract logic, and highlights asymmetric deployments where smaller models benefit from strategy libraries produced by stronger models. No model sizes, dataset scales, or effect sizes are given, so this reads more like a systems proof-of-concept than a large-scale clean benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 想做 agent memory/RAG 可以看它对 semantic leakage 的诊断；但实验信息不够干净，先读问题定义和方法图，别急着把 taxonomy bottleneck 当通用解。
recommendation.en: Worth a look for its semantic-leakage diagnosis in agent memory/RAG, but the setup looks under-specified; read the problem framing and method figure before treating the taxonomy bottleneck as a general solution.

paper.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual e

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程机器人部署中，现有记忆系统存在图像转文本损失细粒度语义、时空关联弱、检索成本高的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新（提出新型视觉时空记忆架构）、系统创新（落地真实机器人），为长时程多模态Agent的记忆设计提供新路径
summary.technical_approach: 提出RAVEN记忆系统，将带位姿、时间戳的视觉嵌入存入向量数据库，结合语义空间地图做检索锚定，直接操作视觉嵌入避免caption的信息损失，支持语义/空间/时间多维度检索

summary.authors_note: 普林斯顿大学、宾夕法尼亚大学团队，Dhruv Shah、Antonio Loquercio为机器人与多模态Agent领域知名研究者

summary_en.importance: Methodological and system innovation; proposes a novel visuo-spatio-temporal memory architecture validated on real robots, providing a new path for long-horizon multimodal agent memory design
summary_en.technical_approach: RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and timestamps in a vector database, grounds retrieval via a semantic spatial map, and operates directly on visual embeddings to avoid captioning information loss, supporting multi-dimensional semantic/spatial/temporal retrieval
