paper.title: SkillAdaptor: Self-Adapting Skills for LLM Agents from Trajectories
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on reusable external skills to solve long-horizon interactive tasks. Existing training-free skill adaptation pipelines usually update skills from full trajectories or session-level feedback, which makes failure attribution coarse and often produces unstable or overly broad revisions. We propose SkillAdaptor, a training-free step-level skill adaptation framework with explicit failure attribution, and it can plug into OpenClaw-class agent harness

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM agent 在失败轨迹上如何做更细粒度、可归因的技能更新，而不是用整段轨迹做粗糙修补。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 侧的方法改进，贡献主要是训练自由的 step-level skill adaptation 机制，而不是基座模型训练范式创新。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它把“失败归因粒度”这个问题讲得更清楚，可作为 post-train / tool-use credit assignment 的旁证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillAdaptor：先在失败轨迹中定位第一个可执行错误步骤，再把责任链接到候选外部技能，对相关技能做定向更新，并通过显式 acceptance check 控制更新是否生效；骨干 LLM 保持冻结，可插入 OpenClaw 一类 agent harness。
summary.experiments: 在 WebShop、PinchBench、Claw-Eval 上，用 Kimi-K2.5、GLM-5、GPT-5.2 评测；相对 no-skill 和已有 skill-adaptation baseline 都有提升，单项最大提升约为 PinchBench Avg Score +1.5、Claw-Eval +1.8。摘要未给出更完整的消融、成本和失败类型分布，结论更像 agent engineering 的正向信号。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles fine-grained, attributable skill updates for long-horizon LLM agents after failed trajectories, instead of coarse full-trajectory revision.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent-side method contribution rather than a foundation-model training advance. Its value to pretraining researchers is indirect: it sharpens the issue of failure attribution granularity, which may inform post-training and tool-use credit assignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillAdaptor identifies the first actionable fault step in a failed trajectory, assigns responsibility to candidate external skills, performs targeted skill updates, and validates them with explicit acceptance checks, while keeping the backbone LLM frozen. It is designed to plug into OpenClaw-style agent harnesses.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on WebShop, PinchBench, and Claw-Eval with Kimi-K2.5, GLM-5, and GPT-5.2. It improves over no-skill and prior skill-adaptation baselines across all three suites, with the largest single-metric gains around +1.5 on PinchBench Avg Score and +1.8 on Claw-Eval. From the abstract alone, the evidence looks useful but still mostly agent-engineering oriented.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，保留它只是因为“失败归因要细到 step 而不是 session”这个判断对 tool-use/RL credit assignment 有参考；读方法图即可。
recommendation.en: Not really a pretraining paper; keep it only for the step-level vs session-level failure attribution idea, which may transfer to tool-use and RL credit assignment.

paper.title: CoHyDE: Iterative Co-Training of LLM Rewriter & Dense Encoder for Tool Retrieval
paper.abstract: Tool retrieval over large API catalogs is a core bottleneck for LLM agents: user queries arrive in colloquial, often underspecified language, while the catalog uses technical API vocabulary that no fixed encoder can bridge on its own. The two dominant training approaches, contrastive encoder fine-tuning and HyDE-style query expansion with a frozen LLM, address this problem from opposite ends and fail in complementary directions: the fine-tuned encoder excels when the query's surface form already

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在大规模 API 目录中检索工具时，用户自然语言查询与技术化 API 描述之间的语义和词表错配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 工具检索方法改进。它把 HyDE 式查询改写和 dense encoder 微调放进同一个迭代训练环路，目标是减少单独训练 encoder 或单独用冻结 LLM 改写时的互补失败。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoHyDE：LLM rewriter 生成更接近 API 目录风格的 hypothetical descriptions，dense encoder 用这些描述进行 InfoNCE 训练；随后 rewriter 根据检索偏好信号进行对齐。方法核心是让生成式改写器和向量检索器共同演化，而不是把 query expansion 当作冻结前处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整实验细节。可确认任务是 tool/API retrieval，比较对象包括 contrastive encoder fine-tuning 与 frozen-LLM HyDE-style query expansion；具体数据集规模、模型大小和提升幅度在提供信息中不可见。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses tool retrieval for LLM agents when user queries are informal or underspecified while API catalogs use technical vocabulary.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-tool retrieval method. Its main contribution is coupling HyDE-style LLM rewriting with dense encoder training, aiming to avoid the failure modes of either component when trained or used in isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoHyDE iteratively trains two components: the LLM rewriter produces catalog-style hypothetical descriptions, and the dense encoder is trained with InfoNCE on those rewritten descriptions. The rewriter is then preference-aligned using retrieval feedback, making rewriting and retrieval co-adapt rather than remain separate modules.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not expose full experimental details. The baselines include contrastive encoder fine-tuning and frozen-LLM HyDE-style query expansion for tool/API retrieval; dataset scale, model size, and exact gains are not available from the snippet.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 价值有限；若做 tool-use 数据或检索监督，只看 co-training loop 设计即可。
recommendation.en: Limited pretrain signal; if you work on tool-use data or retrieval supervision, skim the co-training loop and skip the rest.

paper.title: OmniRetrieval: Unified Retrieval across Heterogeneous Knowledge Sources
paper.abstract: Real-world information needs require access to structurally diverse knowledge sources, from unstructured text and relational tables to knowledge graphs and property graphs. Existing retrievers, however, operate over one source at a time under a fixed query language, leaving the broader landscape of available knowledge fragmented behind incompatible interfaces. A natural attempt at unification would collapse these sources into a shared space, but this erases the structural affordances (such as sc

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言查询需要同时访问文本、关系表、知识图谱、属性图等异构知识源时，现有检索器接口割裂、查询语言不统一的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/agent 检索系统设计。它的重点不是把所有知识压进单一向量空间，而是保留不同知识源的 schema、ontology 和组合查询能力，用统一调度层连接自然语言请求与源生执行引擎。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniRetrieval：输入自然语言查询后，系统识别应访问的知识源，并为不同源生成 source-native queries，再交给各自原生执行引擎处理。方法倾向于 query planning / routing，而不是单一 embedding space 的语义检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在覆盖 13 个数据集的 benchmark 上评估，但提供片段未显示完整结果、模型规模、baseline 列表或提升幅度。可确认评估对象横跨非结构化文本、关系表、知识图谱和属性图等多种知识源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles retrieval over heterogeneous knowledge sources—text, relational tables, knowledge graphs, and property graphs—through a single natural-language interface.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a RAG/agent retrieval framework. Instead of collapsing every source into one vector space, it preserves source-specific affordances such as schemas, ontologies, and compositional operators.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniRetrieval receives a natural-language query, selects the appropriate knowledge sources, generates source-native queries, and dispatches them to native execution engines. The design is closer to routing and query planning than to universal dense retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions an extensive benchmark spanning 13 datasets, but the provided snippet does not include exact results, model sizes, baselines, or gain numbers. The evaluation appears to cover multiple source types including text, relational tables, knowledge graphs, and property graphs.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文；做 RAG 工具路由的人可看系统边界，统一 embedding 的反例论证更有用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper; useful mainly for RAG/tool-routing people, especially the argument against forcing all sources into one embedding space.

paper.title: GAPD: Gold-Action Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Knowledge Base Question Answering
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a natural fit for agentic knowledge base question answering (KBQA), where a model must issue executable actions, observe knowledge-base feedback, and eventually return an answer. However, current RL-based KBQA systems mainly optimize sparse rewards from the final answer, leaving intermediate action errors weakly supervised. This is especially limiting for logical-form annotated KBQA benchmarks: gold logical forms can be converted into executable action sequences, b

summary.core_problem: KBQA中基于RL的方法主要优化最终答案的稀疏奖励，中间动作错误缺乏监督；而gold逻辑形式通常仅用于预热数据构造而非在线RL更新。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出训练时的Gold-Action Policy Distillation框架，为结果驱动的RL添加稠密token级指导。
summary.technical_approach: GAPD通过MID-ANCHOR MATCHING将学生探索和gold执行中到达的中间实体作为状态锚点，将学生状态与gold状态匹配，实现稠密token级监督。
summary.experiments: 在KBQA基准上进行实验，具体模型、基准和结果未在摘要中详述。

summary_en.core_problem: RL-based KBQA systems optimize sparse final-answer rewards, leaving intermediate action errors weakly supervised; gold logical forms are underutilized beyond warm-start data construction.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: a training-time Gold-Action Policy Distillation framework adding dense token-level guidance to outcome-based RL for KBQA.
summary_en.technical_approach: GAPD uses MID-ANCHOR MATCHING: intermediate entities reached during student and gold execution serve as state anchors to align student rollouts with gold action sequences for dense supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on KBQA benchmarks; specifics not fully detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: KBQA特定任务的RL方法改进，将gold动作序列用于稠密监督的思路自然但增量。对通用agent或预训练研究有限。
recommendation.en: Incremental RL improvement specific to KBQA task. Using gold action sequences for dense supervision is natural but not paradigm-changing for general agent or pre-training research.

paper.title: StepOPSD: Step-Aware Online Preference Distillation for Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn agents suffers from a credit-assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and trajectory-level, while success often hinges on a few local decisions. Existing online policy distillation (OPD) provides denser token-level supervision, but typically treats heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings rather than causal interaction units. We present StepOPSD, a post-rollout preference self-distillation framework that takes the agent step as the unit of credi

summary.core_problem: 多轮智能体强化学习存在信用分配错配问题：奖励稀疏且仅在整条轨迹维度发放，而任务成败往往取决于少数局部决策；现有在线策略蒸馏方法将异质的智能体轨迹视为整体字符串，忽略交互的因果单元边界，在环境观测等模型不可控的token上浪费监督信号。
summary.importance: 为智能体后训练阶段的RL与蒸馏信号融合提供了轻量的信用重分配思路，在不改变在线交互逻辑的前提下优化RL的优势估计，对GRPO类RL训练流程的改进有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出以智能体交互步为单位的事后偏好自蒸馏框架StepOPSD。首先将完整轨迹拆解为以行动为中心的步段，过滤掉环境观测等模型不可控的token；为每个步段构造加入事后信息的教师上下文，对比师生模型的token对数概率差，基于标准化的每步信用预算，转换为保留符号的优势塑形项，注入GRPO更新流程。与RLSD对全序列token重加权、SDAR对全序列做软token门控的方法不同，StepOPSD将监督限定在实际驱动智能体行为的行动段内，是现有GRPO pipeline的可插拔模块，完全不改动在线rollout逻辑。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld的Heat、PickTwo子集和Search-QA的TriviaQA、HotpotQA子集上取得最优或次优成绩；消融实验发现更小的局部裁剪阈值α_clip能普遍提升训练稳定性，全局混合强度λ_mix则具有任务依赖性：具身控制任务适合更弱的塑形，检索类QA适合更强的塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读方法章节的步段拆分规则和优势塑形公式，实验部分的双参数调优结论，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning faces a credit assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and distributed only at the full trajectory level, while task success usually depends on a small number of local decisions. Existing online policy distillation methods treat heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings, ignoring causal interaction unit boundaries and wasting supervision on tokens that the model cannot control, such as environment observations.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight credit redistribution approach for integrating RL and distillation signals in agent post-training, optimizing RL advantage estimation without modifying online interaction logic, and has direct reference value for improving GRPO-based RL training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: StepOPSD is a hindsight preference self-distillation framework centered on agent interaction steps. It first decomposes full trajectories into action-centered step segments, filtering out uncontrollable tokens such as environment observations. For each step segment, it constructs a teacher context augmented with hindsight information, compares the token log-probability gap between teacher and student, and converts it into a sign-preserving advantage shaping term based on a normalized per-step credit budget, which is injected into the GRPO update process. Unlike RLSD which reweights all tokens in the full sequence, or SDAR which applies soft token gating over the entire sequence, StepOPSD restricts supervision to action segments that actually drive agent behavior. It is a drop-in module for existing GRPO pipelines and does not change online rollout dynamics at all.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves top-1 or top-2 performance on ALFWorld Heat, PickTwo subsets and Search-QA TriviaQA, HotpotQA subsets. Ablation studies show that smaller local clipping threshold α_clip generally improves training stability, while global mixing strength λ_mix is task-dependent: weaker shaping works better for embodied control tasks, and stronger shaping works better for retrieval QA tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the step segmentation rules and advantage shaping formula in the method section, and the two-parameter tuning conclusions in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 奖励分配细化到 step 级别，对长序列 agent 训练的 credit assignment 有启发，值得关注其 advantage shaping 的具体实现。
recommendation.en: Refining RL reward assignment to the step level offers insights for credit assignment in long-horizon agent training; the advantage shaping implementation is worth checking.

paper.title: Explore Before You Solve: The Speed--Depth Trade-off in Epistemic Agents for ARC-AGI-3
paper.abstract: We systematically investigate all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games and find that every one is reachable through non-intelligent strategies: 10 in a single blind step, 5 after one probing action, 1 via repeated ACTION1 presses, 1 via diverse exploration, and 8 via single repeated actions with sufficient budget (50-200 steps). A library-level null-coordinate vulnerability additionally bypasses 18 games in 1 step. This benchmark critique implies the public evaluation set cannot discriminate intelligent ex

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论 ARC-AGI-3 中“先探索再求解”的必要性，同时指出公开 25 个游戏存在明显可被启发式策略利用的评测漏洞。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，更接近 agent 评测与交互式推理方法分析。它有两个可借鉴点：第一，交互式任务里的能力评估很容易被环境漏洞、动作预算和隐藏规则发现过程污染；第二，模型规模提升不一定替代探索机制，小模型和较大模型在同一任务上可能呈现不同的“探索依赖性”。对研究基座模型的启发主要在 evaluation hygiene 和 epistemic behavior，而不是训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分为两部分。评测批判部分系统枚举 25 个公开 ARC-AGI-3 游戏，发现所有游戏都可由非智能策略触达：10 个可单步盲操作完成，5 个在一次探测后完成，1 个通过重复 ACTION1，1 个通过多样化探索，8 个通过足够预算下重复单一动作完成；此外，一个 library-level null-coordinate 漏洞可在 1 步内绕过 18 个游戏。方法部分提出 AERA，即 EXPLORE / VERIFY / PLAN 三阶段 agent。EXPLORE 先用动作收集环境反馈；VERIFY 用观测修正 world-model hypothesis，并用 belief entropy 的代理信号决定是否继续探索；PLAN 只在假设足够稳定后执行计划。论文还把 RHAE=(H/A)^2 解释为速度与信息深度之间的二阶惩罚，但这个解释依赖凸性假设 A1；作者只在 appendix 中对一类 UIS 环境给出证明。需要注意，约 40% human baseline 的探索预算是小规模消融得到的经验启发，不是理论推出的最优值。
summary.experiments: 公开 25 个游戏上，AERA 达到 RHAE=0.2116，解出 4/25。5 个游戏子集上，Qwen2.5-0.5B + AERA 达到 RHAE=0.5290，而 no-explore baseline 为 0.0000；这个 0 分部分来自 PLAN 模块要求非空假设的架构设定，不应解释为一般性定理。Qwen2.5-1.5B 的 no-explore baseline 达到 RHAE=0.2645，原因是它能仅靠规划解出 FT09，说明探索对 0.5B 是必要条件，但在该子集上对 1.5B 并非总是必要。FT09 上，0.5B 模型 8/8 次成功，但作者也说明成功机制涉及 ACTION6 error 后紧接 SOLVED，机制尚未完全确认。论文关联的 ARC-AGI-3 code track 提交使用 BFS solver 与 offline pre-solve cache，在 55 个私有游戏上 RHAE=0.30；这更像竞争系统结果，不完全等同于 AERA 的受控实验。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 introduction 中的贡献边界和 provenance note，因为作者较清楚地区分了理论解释、工程启发和不确定实验现象。然后看公开 25 个游戏的漏洞分析，这部分比 agent 架构更有评测价值。AERA 的 EXPLORE / VERIFY / PLAN 设计可以快速扫读，重点看 belief entropy gating 的具体实现和 no-explore baseline 的定义。理论部分只需看 Proposition 1 的假设条件，不必投入太多时间，除非关心 RHAE 指标设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why an ARC-AGI-3 agent should explore before committing to a plan, while also showing that the 25 public games are too vulnerable to simple heuristics to serve as a reliable intelligence test.
summary_en.importance: The paper is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining. Its useful signal is about evaluation design for interactive reasoning: hidden-rule environments can confound planning ability with exploration policy, action budget, and environment bugs. It also gives a concrete example where scaling the model does not cleanly replace epistemic control. The main value for foundation-model researchers is in benchmark hygiene and uncertainty-aware interaction, not in pretraining algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has a benchmark-analysis component and an agent-design component. The benchmark analysis enumerates all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games and finds that each can be reached by non-intelligent strategies: 10 by a single blind action, 5 after one probe, 1 by repeated ACTION1, 1 through diverse exploration, and 8 by repeating one action with a 50–200 step budget. A library-level null-coordinate issue bypasses 18 games in one step. The agent, AERA, uses three phases: EXPLORE to collect observations, VERIFY to update an explicit world-model hypothesis, and PLAN to act only after uncertainty is reduced. The transition is gated by a proxy for belief entropy. The paper also interprets RHAE=(H/A)^2 as a quadratic speed-depth penalty under a convexity assumption. That theory is conditional; the adaptive exploration budget of roughly 40% of the human baseline is an empirical heuristic from a very small ablation, not a derived optimum.
summary_en.experiments: On the 25 public games, AERA obtains RHAE=0.2116 and solves 4/25. On a 5-game subset, Qwen2.5-0.5B with AERA reaches RHAE=0.5290, while the no-explore baseline gets 0.0000; the zero score is partly due to an architectural choice that prevents planning without a non-empty hypothesis. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, the no-explore baseline reaches RHAE=0.2645 by solving FT09 through planning alone, so exploration is essential for the 0.5B model but not always required for the larger one on this subset. FT09 is solved in 8/8 runs by the 0.5B setup, but the mechanism involves an ACTION6 error immediately before SOLVED and remains only partially understood. The related code-track submission uses a BFS solver with an offline pre-solve cache and reports RHAE=0.30 on the 55-game private set, which should be read as a competition-system result rather than a clean ablation of AERA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the introduction and provenance notes, because they clearly mark which claims are theoretical, empirical, or still uncertain. Then read the public-game vulnerability analysis; it is the most useful part for evaluation design. The EXPLORE / VERIFY / PLAN architecture is worth a quick pass, especially the belief-entropy gate and the exact definition of the no-explore baseline. The theory section can be read selectively; the key is the convexity assumption behind the RHAE interpretation.

recommendation.zh: 对 ARC-AGI-3 基准的批评切中要害——公共集可被漏洞利用这一事实对所有使用该基准的研究都是重要提醒，重点读 §3 漏洞分析和 §4 Speed-Depth 框架。
recommendation.en: The critique of ARC-AGI-3 is incisive—the fact that the public set is exploitable is a critical reminder for all research using this benchmark; focus on §3 vulnerability analysis and §4 Speed-Depth framework.

paper.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on reusable skills to solve complex tasks. However, existing skill creation approaches treat skills as isolated and static artifacts, limiting their reusability, reliability, and long-term improvement. We propose MUSE-Autoskill Agent (Memory-Utilizing Skill Evolution), a skill-centric agent framework that lets agents continuously improve their task-solving capability by creating, reusing, and refining skills under a unified lifecycle (creation, memory, mana

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 的技能创建、复用、管理和持续改进彼此割裂的问题，使技能不再是一次性静态产物。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 框架工作，贡献在 skill lifecycle 管理，而不是基座模型训练。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但它提供了一个可观察的 post-train/agent memory 设计点：把经验沉淀到 skill 级别，而不是只沉淀到对话级别。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MUSE-Autoskill，将技能生命周期统一为 creation、memory、management、evaluation 和 refinement。系统支持按需创建技能、跨任务存储和复用、组织与选择技能，并通过单元测试和运行时反馈持续修正。额外引入 skill-level memory，累积每个技能跨任务的经验，以提升复用和适配效果。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 SkillsBench 上，摘要称生命周期管理的技能能提升任务表现，但未给出模型规模、训练数据、强基线和提升幅度。更像 agent framework 的初步证据，而不是足够干净的能力归因研究。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the fragmentation between skill creation, reuse, management, and continual improvement in LLM agents, so that skills are no longer static one-off artifacts.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent framework paper, with the main contribution in skill lifecycle management rather than foundation-model training. Its value to pretraining researchers is limited, though it offers one useful post-train/agent-memory idea: storing experience at the skill level rather than only at the dialogue level.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes MUSE-Autoskill, unifying the skill lifecycle into creation, memory, management, evaluation, and refinement. The system supports on-demand skill creation, cross-task storage and reuse, organization and selection, and continual refinement through unit tests and runtime feedback. It also introduces skill-level memory that accumulates experience for each skill across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are mainly on SkillsBench. The abstract claims that lifecycle-managed skills improve task performance, but it does not provide model scale, training data, strong baselines, or effect sizes. This reads more like initial framework evidence than a clean capability attribution study.

recommendation.zh: agent memory/skill 库方向的常规推进，和基座预训练不直接相连；只看技能生命周期设计即可，实验先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: This is a fairly standard step in agent memory/skill libraries, not tightly connected to foundation pretraining; read the lifecycle design and treat the experiments as weak evidence.

paper.title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
paper.abstract: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three system

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图让 agent 的长程推理不再完全依赖无结构 chain-of-thought，而是显式区分执行、模拟规划和是否规划的自我调控。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，主要启发在训练数据格式和推理计算控制。它说明 agent trace 不一定只是一长串自由文本 reasoning，也可以拆成“何时规划、规划多远、预测什么状态、何时直接行动”等结构化监督信号。这个方向可能影响后续 agent 预训练或 mid-training 的 trace schema 设计。
summary.technical_approach: SR2AM 把 agent 推理拆成三个系统：System I 负责反应式执行和自由推理；System II 负责 simulative planning，即提出候选动作并预测未来状态；System III 是 configurator，决定当前是否需要新规划、继续已有规划，还是直接行动。实现上仍使用 LLM 作为世界模型，在 chain-of-thought 内插入结构化的配置与规划阶段。作者给出两个版本：v0.1 从多模块 prompting 系统记录决策来构造训练信号；v1.0 从预训练 reasoning LLM 的轨迹中重建结构化计划，以提高可扩展性。训练流程是监督学习后接 RL。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖数学、科学、表格分析和网页信息查找等交互式推理任务。SR2AM-v0.1-8B 的 Pass@1 与 120B–355B 级别系统接近；SR2AM-v1.0-30B 与 685B–1T 级别 agentic LLM 接近。v1.0-30B 相比相近规模 agentic LLM 节省 25.8%–95.3% reasoning tokens。分析显示，RL 后平均 planning horizon 增加 22.8%，planning frequency 只增加 2.0 个百分点，说明模型更倾向于在少数需要规划的位置规划得更远，而不是简单增加规划次数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看三系统形式化定义，确认 configurator、planner、executor 的边界。再看 v0.1 和 v1.0 的数据构造方式，尤其是如何从普通 reasoning trace 重建结构化计划。实验部分重点看 token 节省和 planning horizon/frequency 的分析。对基座研究员来说，不必细读具体 agent benchmark 细节，重点是 trace 结构和 RL 后计算分配行为的变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient long-horizon agent reasoning caused by unstructured chain-of-thought. It proposes to separate execution, simulation-based planning, and self-regulation over when and how deeply to plan.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to base-model pretraining is indirect. The useful signal is about trace design and compute control: agent training traces can expose decisions such as whether to plan, how far to plan, what future states to predict, and when to act directly. Such schemas may become useful for agent-oriented pretraining, mid-training, or RL data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: SR2AM decomposes reasoning into three components. System I performs reactive execution and free-form reasoning. System II performs simulative planning by proposing actions and predicting future belief states, using the LLM itself as the world model. System III is a configurator that decides whether to create a new plan, continue an existing plan, or act without planning. The authors instantiate this in two ways. v0.1 records decisions from a multi-module prompted system to demonstrate feasibility. v1.0 reconstructs structured plans from pretrained reasoning LLM traces for better scalability. Both versions are trained with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers interactive reasoning in math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking. SR2AM-v0.1-8B achieves Pass@1 competitive with systems in the 120B–355B range. SR2AM-v1.0-30B is reported as competitive with 685B–1T agentic LLMs. The 30B model uses 25.8%–95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than competitive agentic LLMs of similar scale. After RL, average planning horizon increases by 22.8%, while planning frequency grows by only 2.0 percentage points, suggesting that the model learns to plan further ahead at selected moments rather than planning more often everywhere.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the formal definition of the three systems to understand the boundaries between configurator, planner, and executor. Then read the v0.1 and v1.0 data construction pipelines, especially how structured plans are reconstructed from ordinary reasoning traces. In the experiments, focus on reasoning-token savings and the analysis of planning horizon versus planning frequency. The benchmark-specific details are less important for pretraining researchers than the trace schema and the post-RL shift in computation allocation.

recommendation.zh: 只看 planner 调用率与 token-cost 曲线；如果没有干净消融，它就是又一个三系统 agent 叙事。
recommendation.en: Skim the planner-invocation and token-cost curves; without clean ablations, this is just another three-system agent story.

paper.title: To Call or Not to Call: Diagnosing Intrinsic Over-Calling Bias in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents exhibit a consistent tendency to over-call, invoking tools even in situations where none is needed. On the When2Call benchmark, six models from three families show high call accuracy but much lower no-call accuracy, leaving overall accuracy in the 55%-70% range. We trace this to an Intrinsic Bias Hypothesis (IBH): the call/no-call decision mapping carries an activation-independent call offset, so the model favors call even at activation parity. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), we rec

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM Agent 的工具过度调用问题：模型在不需要调用工具时仍倾向于发起调用。作者关注的不是工具调用格式是否正确，而是 call / no_call 这个门控决策为什么偏向 call。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析和干预论文，对预训练本身不是直接改进，但对工具使用数据、SFT/RL 信号设计和 Agent 对齐有参考价值。它把过度调用解释为决策映射中的 activation-independent call offset，而不只是 call 特征激活更强。这个结论提示：如果训练数据或奖励长期偏向“能调用就调用”，模型可能学到一个稳定的调用偏置；仅靠增强 no-call 样本或调 prompt 未必能完全修正，需要在门控边界、损失权重或偏置校准上处理。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在六个模型上训练 Sparse Autoencoder，包括 Qwen3.5 4B/9B、Gemma-3-it 1B/4B、Ministral-3-Instruct 3B/8B。SAE 接在中后层 residual stream，使用 TopK SAE，字典大小 M=8d，激活数 K=floor(d/32)。训练分两阶段：先用 OpenWebText2 约 50M tokens 学通用稀疏基，再用 When2Call 约 10M tokens 适配工具调用上下文。随后在 action-boundary 位置提取残差激活，按模型实际输出把样本分成 call 和 no_call，筛选行为相关的 SAE features，并用线性 probe 验证这些 features 接近 residual-stream 可达到的预测上限。核心分析是把 call 与 no_call feature bases 压缩成 signed activation margin，估计决策边界是否在 activation parity 处。结果显示中性边界向 no_call 一侧偏移：只有 no_call 激活超过 call 激活时，模型才接近决策中性。最后作者提出 Adaptive Margin-Calibrated Steering，沿 SAE decoder 方向施加闭式 counter-bias shift，用干预实验检验这个 offset 是否具有因果作用。
summary.experiments: 在 When2Call 上，六个模型都表现出较高 call accuracy 和明显较低 no-call accuracy，总体准确率大约在 55%–70%。SAE feature bases 能较好预测模型的 call / no_call 决策，并且同一组方向还可以区分 true call 和 false call。IBH 的实验证据来自两部分：一是 activation margin 的几何边界在 parity 处仍偏向 call；二是 logistic 估计得到非零 call offset。AMCS 干预后，五个模型的 no-call accuracy 提升 4–17 个百分点，总体准确率最高提升约 5 个百分点，同时对 call accuracy 的影响较小。这个结果说明偏置不只是相关性现象，沿诊断出的 SAE 方向做校准可以改变行为。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 分钟。重点看第 3 节的 SAE feature discovery，确认行为标签、hook 位置、TopK SAE 训练和 feature ranking 如何做。第 4 节是核心，尤其是 signed activation margin、neutral boundary 和 offset 的估计方式。第 5 节看 AMCS 的闭式 steering 公式和干预结果。附录里的 SAE 训练细节、judge prompt、每个模型的 response-label counts 值得快速检查，因为这些会影响机制解释的可信度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies over-calling in tool-using LLM agents: models often invoke a tool even when the right behavior is to ask for missing information or answer without a tool. The target is the gating decision between call and no_call, not the syntax or execution quality of tool calls.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a mechanistic interpretability and intervention paper. Its relevance to pretraining and post-training lies in the training signal: tool-use data and rewards can induce a persistent call bias rather than merely stronger call-related activations. The finding suggests that no-call behavior may need explicit boundary calibration, loss balancing, or reward design, instead of relying only on prompt instructions or additional negative examples.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train TopK sparse autoencoders on residual-stream activations for six models: Qwen3.5 4B/9B, Gemma-3-it 1B/4B, and Ministral-3-Instruct 3B/8B. The SAE dictionary has size M=8d and keeps K=floor(d/32) active features. Training uses a two-stage curriculum: around 50M OpenWebText2 tokens for broad residual-space coverage, followed by around 10M When2Call tokens for tool-use adaptation. At the action boundary, the residual activation is encoded into SAE features. Features are ranked by their association with the model’s observed call or no_call behavior, then validated with linear probes. The central test compresses call and no_call feature bases into a signed activation margin and asks whether equal activation produces a neutral decision. It does not: the neutral boundary is shifted, which supports an activation-independent call offset. The paper then applies Adaptive Margin-Calibrated Steering, a closed-form shift along SAE decoder directions, to cancel the diagnosed offset.
summary_en.experiments: On When2Call, all six models show high call accuracy but much lower no-call accuracy, with overall accuracy in the 55%–70% range. The recovered SAE feature bases predict call/no_call behavior close to the residual-stream probe ceiling. Margin geometry and logistic estimation both indicate a shifted boundary: the model becomes neutral only when no_call activation exceeds call activation. With AMCS, no-call accuracy improves by 4–17 points on five of six models, and overall accuracy improves by up to about 5 points, while valid tool-call accuracy is mostly preserved. This provides a causal check that the diagnosed offset is behaviorally relevant.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Section 3 is needed to judge whether the SAE features are behavior-aligned and not just artifacts of the labeling pipeline. Section 4 is the main technical section: focus on the signed activation margin and the offset estimate. Section 5 is useful for the causal intervention, especially the AMCS formula and per-model trade-offs between no-call gains and call accuracy. The appendices on SAE training, hook locations, judge prompts, and response-label counts are worth checking for robustness.

recommendation.zh: 用SAE做Agent行为偏差的机制诊断+因果干预，方法对理解LLM决策内在结构有参考，重点看SAE特征提取和AMCS干预部分。
recommendation.en: Mechanistic diagnosis of agent behavior bias using SAEs + causal intervention. Informative for understanding LLM internal decision structure; focus on SAE feature extraction and AMCS intervention sections.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong Shenzhen
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization
paper.abstract: LLM agents organize behavior through skills - structured natural-language specifications governing how an agent reasons, retrieves, and responds. Unlike monolithic prompts, skills are multi-field artifacts subject to hard platform constraints: description fields are truncated for routing, instruction bodies are compacted via progressive disclosure, and co-resident skills compete for limited context windows. These constraints make skill optimization inherently multi-objective: a skill must simult

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 中“技能”提示在任务效果、字段长度、上下文竞争等多重约束下难以联合优化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent prompt/skill optimization 方法改进。它把技能优化从单目标分数提升到 Pareto 前沿搜索，对真实平台约束有一定工程意义，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MOCHA，用 Chebyshev scalarization 替代加权和目标，以覆盖非凸 Pareto 区域；再结合指数退火，在早期探索不同技能变体，后期转向利用较优解。方法针对多字段技能规格、路由截断、progressive disclosure 压缩和上下文预算竞争。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、任务集、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的实验目标应是比较 MOCHA 与单目标或加权和 prompt optimizer 在多约束 skill 优化中的 Pareto 覆盖和任务表现。
summary.authors_note: Adobe Research 工作，面向实际 agent 平台中的技能管理与优化问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to optimize LLM-agent skills under multiple simultaneous constraints, including task performance, field truncation, progressive disclosure, and context-window competition.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level improvement for agent prompt or skill optimization. It is useful for production agent systems, but it is only weakly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MOCHA replaces weighted-sum selection with Chebyshev scalarization to better cover non-convex Pareto regions, and adds exponential annealing to move from exploration to exploitation. The setup treats skills as structured multi-field artifacts rather than single monolithic prompts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation appears to compare MOCHA against single-objective or weighted-sum prompt optimizers on Pareto coverage and task performance under platform constraints.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Adobe Research, focused on skill optimization in practical agent platforms.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法框架即可；Chebyshev 标量化比加权和干净，但这是 agent 平台调参，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method only; Chebyshev scalarization is cleaner than weighted sums, but this is agent-platform tuning rather than a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Contexting as Recommendation: Evolutionary Collaborative Filtering for Context Engineering
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to their input contexts, motivating the development of automated context engineering. However, existing methods predominantly treat this as a global search problem, seeking a single context strategy that maximizes average performance across a dataset. This restrictive assumption overlooks the fact that different inputs often require distinct guidance, leaving substantial instance-level performance gains untapped. In this paper, we propose a parad

summary.core_problem: 解决自动 context engineering 只寻找“全局最优提示/上下文策略”、忽略样本级差异的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 prompt/context routing 方向的思路改写：把 context engineering 从全局搜索改成推荐系统问题。对预训练研究员的直接价值一般，但它提醒了一点：输入条件分布是高度异质的，单一上下文策略常常不是最优。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 NCCE。先构建一组多样化 anchor contexts，再用 Neural Collaborative Filtering 学习“样本—上下文”匹配关系，并通过 Context-CF Co-Evolution 让上下文库与推荐模型共同演化。核心创新是 instance-wise routing，而不是更强的 prompt 搜索器。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、任务集、提升幅度和强基线细节。预期实验会对比全局 prompt search、静态 context engineering 和若干 routing 方法。若要判断是否可信，关键是看冷启动、catalog 大小时的收益曲线，以及推荐器本身的额外成本是否吞掉增益。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 UCL 等机构研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles a limitation of automated context engineering: most methods search for a single globally optimal context strategy and ignore instance-level heterogeneity.
summary_en.importance: This reframes context engineering as a recommendation problem rather than global prompt search. Its direct relevance to pretraining is modest, but it does highlight an important systems-level point: input distributions are heterogeneous, and one context policy is often suboptimal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes NCCE. It first bootstraps a diverse catalog of anchor contexts, then uses neural collaborative filtering to learn instance-context matching, with a co-evolution mechanism that jointly improves the context catalog and the recommender. The main idea is instance-wise routing rather than a stronger prompt search algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model sizes, tasks, gains, or strong baselines. Presumably it compares against global prompt/context search and static context engineering methods. The key credibility checks are cold-start behavior, gains as the context catalog grows, and whether the routing overhead offsets the performance improvements.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes researchers affiliated with UCL and collaborators.

recommendation.zh: 更像 prompt routing 的 recommender 化，离预训练较远；只看方法图和消融，确认 instance-wise context selection 是否真有稳定收益。
recommendation.en: This is basically prompt routing recast as recommendation, not a pretraining paper; just inspect the method figure and ablations to see if instance-wise context selection really holds up.

paper.title: Thinking Ahead: Prospection-Guided Retrieval of Memory with Language Models
paper.abstract: Long-horizon personalization requires dialogue assistants to retrieve user-specific facts from extended interaction histories. In practice, many relevant facts often have low semanticsimilarity to the query under dense retrieval. Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG systems are still largely retrospective: they rely on embedding similarity to the query or on fixed graph traversals, so they often miss facts that matter for the user's needs but lie far from the query in embed

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG、GraphRAG等检索系统均为回溯式设计，依赖查询与记忆的嵌入相似度或预构建的图遍历规则，无法召回与查询语义相似度低但对用户未来需求至关重要的潜在记忆，成为长周期个性化交互的核心瓶颈。
summary.importance: 打破了传统检索范式中存储结构与检索策略的强耦合，首次将认知科学中的前瞻模拟机制引入大模型记忆检索，为长周期智能体记忆系统设计提供了全新范式；配套的MemoryQuest基准填补了长周期跨域潜在记忆检索评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出前瞻引导检索（PGR），是独立于底层存储介质的检索策略，可与向量库、实体图、事件日志等任意存储结构兼容。核心为迭代的模拟-检索-优化循环：收到用户查询后，先用思维树或线性链模拟多个未来可能的任务轨迹，每个模拟步骤触发对应相关记忆的召回，再用召回的记忆修正模拟轨迹，直到覆盖所有潜在需求。与现有方法的核心区别是完全脱离存储结构限制，无需预构建索引或边关系，通过实时前瞻推理挖掘记忆间的潜在关联。
summary.experiments: 构建了MemoryQuest多会话基准，包含时间线一致、跨域分布、与查询语义相似度低的3~5条关联记忆的查询任务，专门针对回溯式检索的瓶颈。在1500+查询、3个基准上的实验显示，PGR的检索召回率和响应质量显著优于标准RAG、GraphRAG等基线，人工评测与大模型评测的结果对齐度高。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第1章引言中的前瞻机制原理和检索解耦核心逻辑、第2章的PGR迭代循环设计、第4章的MemoryQuest基准构造规则、第5章的消融实验（对比不同模拟策略、不同存储介质下的性能差异）。值得深挖的方向包括前瞻模拟的token开销优化、与预训练阶段记忆能力的结合方式、降低推理延迟适配实时交互的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval systems including standard RAG and GraphRAG follow a retrospective paradigm, relying on embedding similarity between queries and memories or pre-defined graph traversal rules. They fail to retrieve latent memories with low semantic similarity to the query but critical for users' future needs, which forms a core bottleneck for long-horizon personalized interactions.
summary_en.importance: PGR breaks the tight coupling between storage structure and retrieval strategy in traditional retrieval paradigms. It introduces the prospection mechanism from cognitive science into LLM memory retrieval for the first time, providing a new paradigm for long-horizon agent memory system design. The accompanying MemoryQuest benchmark fills the gap in evaluating cross-domain latent memory retrieval for long-term interactions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prospection-Guided Retrieval (PGR) is a retrieval policy independent of underlying storage media, compatible with vector stores, entity graphs, and episodic logs. Its core is an iterative Simulate-Retrieve-Refine loop: after receiving a user query, it first simulates multiple possible future task trajectories via Tree-of-Thought or linear chains, triggers retrieval of relevant memories at each simulated step, then revises the simulation trajectory with retrieved memories until all potential needs are covered. Unlike existing methods, it does not rely on pre-built indexes or edge relations, and mines latent associations between memories via real-time prospective reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The MemoryQuest multi-session benchmark is constructed, with queries that require retrieving 3~5 cross-domain associated memories with low semantic similarity to the query and consistent chronological dependencies, targeting the bottleneck of retrospective retrieval. Experiments on over 1500 queries across 3 benchmarks show that PGR significantly outperforms baselines including standard RAG and GraphRAG on retrieval recall and response quality. Results from human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge are highly aligned.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the prospection mechanism and core logic of retrieval decoupling in Chapter 1, the design of the PGR iterative loop in Chapter 2, the construction rules of the MemoryQuest benchmark in Chapter 4, and ablation experiments in Chapter 5 (comparing performance under different simulation strategies and storage media). Points worth further exploration include token overhead optimization for prospective simulation, integration with memory capabilities during pre-training, and reduction of inference latency for real-time interaction scenarios.

recommendation.zh: MSR 的 RAG 记忆检索小方法；只看 ToT probe 构造和失败案例，别把它当长期记忆范式改写。
recommendation.en: A compact MSR memory-retrieval idea; read the ToT-probe construction and failure cases, but do not overread it as a new long-term-memory paradigm.

paper.title: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
paper.abstract: Whether navigating a building, operating a robot, or playing a game, an agent that acts effectively in an environment must first learn an internal model of how that environment works. Partially-observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) provide a flexible modeling class for such internal world models, but learning them from observation-action trajectories alone is challenging and typically requires extensive environment interaction. We ask whether language-model priors can reduce costly inter

summary.core_problem: 现有基于LLM先验的世界模型学习方法（如WorldCoder、POMDP Coder）均依赖完全可观测假设或事后真实状态访问（post-hoc full observability），无法应用于遮挡环境、不完全信息博弈等严格POMDP场景。论文研究仅从观测-动作-奖励轨迹出发，能否利用LLM先验诱导出可执行的POMDP世界模型，而无需访问真实隐状态。
summary.importance: 首次证明LLM先验足以在严格POMDP设置（无真实隐状态监督）下诱导结构化世界模型。这扩展了LLM在具身智能和强化学习中的适用边界——从完全可观测任务推进到部分可观测任务，为减少环境交互成本提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Pinductor（POMDP-inductor）方法，分为两个核心阶段：(1) LLM提议阶段：让LLM根据少量观测-动作-奖励轨迹编写POMDP各组件（转移函数、观测函数、奖励函数、初始状态分布）的候选程序；(2) 迭代精炼阶段：使用基于信念的似然得分（belief-based likelihood score）来评分和优化候选模型。具体通过距离核函数将观测预测转化为软似然，并在模型自身滤波动力学诱导的信念分布下计算期望似然。该目标仅依赖观测和自诱导信念，无需特权状态信息。
summary.experiments: 在5个不同复杂度的MiniGrid POMDP环境上评估。关键结果：(1) Pinductor在使用严格更少信息（无真实状态）的情况下，与使用特权状态的LLM基线（POMDP Coder）达到相当的样本效率和奖励性能；(2) 大幅优于传统表格POMDP基线（后者在少量轨迹下难以学习）；(3) 消融实验表明性能随LLM能力提升而提高，且当环境语义信息被隐藏时性能下降，确认了方法对LLM和文本信息的强依赖性；(4) 诱导的信念状态在规划过程中逐渐收敛到真实隐状态。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第1章引言中的问题界定（为什么无监督POMDP诱导是未解决问题）、第3章方法中的信念似然评分机制（第3.2节 kernel-based likelihood objective）、第4章实验中的基准对比数据。阅读时间约30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的全文片段中明确给出。作者信息未提供。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-based world model induction methods (WorldCoder, POMDP Coder) rely on full observability or post-hoc ground-truth state access, making them inapplicable to strictly partially-observable settings (occluded environments, imperfect-information games). This paper investigates whether LLM priors can induce executable POMDP world models from observation-action-reward trajectories alone, without any ground-truth latent state supervision.
summary_en.importance: First demonstration that LLM priors suffice for structured world model induction in the strict POMDP setting without privileged state supervision. This extends the applicability of LLM priors in embodied AI and reinforcement learning from fully observable to partially observable tasks, providing a path toward reducing expensive environment interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pinductor (POMDP-inductor) operates in two core phases: (1) LLM proposal: an LLM writes candidate programs for POMDP components (transition, observation, reward, initial-state distributions) given a few observation-action-reward trajectories; (2) Iterative refinement: a belief-based likelihood score optimizes candidate models. Observation predictions are converted to soft likelihoods via a distance kernel, and candidates are scored under the expected likelihood of the belief distributions induced by their own filtering dynamics. This objective requires only observations and self-induced beliefs, no privileged state information.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 5 MiniGrid POMDP environments of varying complexity. Key results: (1) Pinductor matches the sample efficiency and reward performance of a privileged-state LLM baseline (POMDP Coder) despite using strictly less information; (2) Substantially outperforms classical tabular POMDP baselines which struggle with few trajectories; (3) Ablations show performance scales with LLM capability and degrades when semantic information is withheld, confirming strong dependence on LLM and textual cues; (4) Induced belief states converge toward the true latent state during planning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 1 for problem framing (why unsupervised POMDP induction is an open question), Section 3.2 for the kernel-based belief likelihood scoring mechanism, and Section 4 for benchmark comparison data. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided text excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和实验设置即可；它给 agent world model 一个较干净的 LM-prior 测试床，但别外推到开放环境。
recommendation.en: Read the method and setup; it is a fairly clean testbed for LM priors in agent world models, but do not extrapolate it to open-ended environments.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking
paper.abstract: Most existing large language models (LLMs) are expensive to adapt after deployment, especially when a task requires newly produced information or niche domain knowledge. Recent work has shown that, by manipulating and optimizing their context, LLMs can be tailored to downstream tasks without updating their weights. However, most existing methods remain closed-loop, relying solely on the model's intrinsic knowledge. In this paper, we equip these context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browse

summary.core_problem: 解决部署后不更新权重的 LLM 如何通过优化上下文并主动检索外部信息来适配新任务和长尾知识的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是上下文优化与工具使用方法。它对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但能提供一个信号：模型能力越来越依赖上下文构造、检索策略和候选上下文搜索，而不是单次 prompt engineering。
summary.technical_approach: 在已有 context optimizer 上加入 Wikipedia search 与 browser tools，并指出简单串行地把工具接入上下文优化会降低性能。论文改用 search-based training，维护多个候选上下文，在搜索过程中剪枝，避免单一路径早期错误污染最终上下文。
summary.experiments: 覆盖低资源翻译 Flores+、健康场景等多领域任务。摘要称主动信息获取与多候选上下文搜索结合后有一致且显著收益，但未给出模型规模、具体 LLM、检索预算、baseline 名称和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 给定机构为 The University of Edinburgh；Arthur Szlam 和 Marc'Aurelio Ranzato 是大模型与强化学习/序列建模领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how deployed LLMs can adapt to new tasks and niche or newly produced knowledge by optimizing context and actively seeking external information, without updating model weights.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method for context optimization with tool use. Its direct pretraining value is limited, but it gives a useful signal: downstream competence can depend heavily on context search, retrieval policy, and candidate management rather than one-shot prompt design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work augments context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools. It finds that naively inserting tools into a standard sequential context optimization pipeline can hurt performance. The proposed alternative uses search-based training, keeps multiple candidate contexts, and prunes them to reduce early-path error lock-in.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans low-resource translation on Flores+, health scenarios, and other domains. The abstract reports consistent and substantial gains from active information seeking when paired with multi-candidate context search, but does not provide model sizes, exact LLMs, retrieval budgets, baseline names, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is The University of Edinburgh; Arthur Szlam and Marc'Aurelio Ranzato are well-known researchers in large-scale learning, reinforcement learning, and sequence modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文；看 abstract 和算法图即可，关键点是“加工具会变差，搜索式上下文训练才稳”。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; the useful bit is that adding tools can hurt unless context optimization is treated as search with pruning.

paper.title: MEME: Multi-entity & Evolving Memory Evaluation
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in persistent environments where they must store, update, and reason over information across many sessions. While prior benchmarks evaluate only single-entity updates, MEME defines six tasks spanning the full space defined by the multi-entity and evolving axes, including three not scored by prior work: Cascade and Absence (dependency reasoning) and Deletion (post-removal state). Evaluating six memory systems spanning three memory paradigms on 100 controlled

summary.core_problem: 评测“长期记忆”系统在多轮、多会话环境里，面对多实体且会演化的事实时，是否能做对三类关键但长期被忽略的操作：依赖传播（Cascade）、不确定性识别（Absence）、以及删除后的状态一致性（Deletion）。论文要解决的不是“能不能检索到旧信息”，而是“更新发生后，系统能否在依赖关系下给出当前世界状态的正确回答”。
summary.importance: 对做 LLM agent 记忆/持续交互的预训练研究有两点直接影响。第一，它把失败模式从“检索召回不足”推进到“状态语义不一致”：很多系统把规则和更新都存进去了，但检索排序与回答策略会把旧值当成真值，导致依赖推理崩溃。第二，它给出了一个可控、可验证、可诊断的评测框架（DAG 依赖 + 可构造 gold），适合用来检验：记忆写入策略、检索器排序、以及是否需要在写入阶段做‘传播/归一化’。这类问题最终会反哺预训练：如果希望模型具备跨会话的状态建模能力，训练信号可能需要显式覆盖“更新-传播-不确定性”的序列决策，而不是只做静态检索式 QA。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是用两个正交维度组织任务空间：实体范围（单实体/多实体）× 时间动态（静态/演化），在四个象限里选取 6 个代表性任务，刻意避开已有 benchmark 已覆盖的“简单变体”。六个任务分别是：
1) Exact Recall：单实体静态，字符级复述，测编码保真；
2) Aggregation：多实体静态，跨 session 聚合，测覆盖与组合；
3) Tracking：单实体演化，输出完整修订历史，测是否保留旧值而非覆盖；
4) Deletion：单实体演化的删除语义，测是否停止报告被删除事实；
5) Cascade：多实体演化 + 依赖规则，父实体更新后推导子实体新值（依赖传播）；
6) Absence：多实体演化 + 依赖断裂，父实体变化但无替代规则时，正确答案应为“不确定/未知”，而不是沿用旧值。

数据生成用 DAG 知识图谱 G=(V,E,Phi) 来保证可验证性：实体是节点，依赖是有向边，Phi 是条件规则（父节点取值触发子节点取值变化）。对每个 episode：采样实体子集与任务，生成多轮对话，把关键事实与“filler 噪声”交错成 haystack。论文还做了一个关键的“可解性验证”：把 gold facts 直接喂给回答 LLM，确认任务在推理层面可解，从而把失败归因更多压到记忆系统（写入/检索/更新）而不是题目本身。

诊断结论很工程化：多数系统并非没存到更新事件或依赖规则，而是检索阶段旧值更容易被召回/排序更靠前（尤其向量检索），或工具式/图式/稀疏检索没把关键更新 surfaced，导致回答模型沿用旧值。真正出现“闭环修复”的路径是：在写入阶段就用更强的内部 LLM 做传播，把推导后的新值直接写回 store，让检索变成“取当前值”而不是“取证据再推理”。代价是成本显著上升。
summary.experiments:
评测覆盖 6 套系统、3 类记忆范式：raw retrieval（直接检索原始对话块）、LLM-processed memory（抽取/结构化/重写记忆）、file-based agent（LLM 通过工具维护持久文件）。数据为 100 个受控 episodes，跨两个域：Personal Life 与 Software Project。

关键数字：在默认配置下，所有系统在依赖推理任务上几乎崩溃：Cascade 平均准确率约 3%，Absence 约 1%（文中也给出更接近 0 的表述：0.03/0.01 量级）。而在静态检索类任务上表现“看起来还行”，说明问题不在基本召回。

干预实验：prompt 优化、更深检索（扩大 top-k / 多轮检索）、减少 filler 噪声、换更强的 answering LLM，都无法实质性弥合 Cas/Abs 的差距。

唯一显著改善来自一种“写入时传播”的配置：MD-flat 在内部使用 Opus 4.7 作为 ingest LLM，把传播后的值写入 store，从而让检索直接命中正确当前值；但成本约为 baseline 的 ~70×。这组结果把 trade-off 说得很清楚：要么在检索+回答阶段承担推理与排序鲁棒性，要么在写入阶段付出高成本做规范化与传播。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“任务定义→数据生成→失败诊断→闭环修复”顺序读。
- 先看任务空间与 Figure 1/2（六任务的覆盖与例子），把 Cascade/Absence/Deletion 的 gold 语义吃透，尤其 Absence 的“应答为不确定”这一点。
- 再看 DAG 生成与规则 Phi 的定义：它决定了为什么 gold 可验证、也决定了依赖传播链的难度。
- 精读实验诊断部分：作者如何证明‘信息其实存进去了但检索/排序把旧值顶上来’，以及不同检索范式各自的 failure mode。
- 最后看 Opus 4.7 ingest 的闭环案例：它不是简单“换更强模型”，而是把推理位置从 answering 移到 ingest（写入时传播），这是设计记忆系统/训练目标时最值得深挖的点。
预计泛读 30–45 分钟可掌握结论；要复现或改系统，需细读数据生成与评测脚本假设（尤其 filler 噪声与 episode 结构）。

summary_en.core_problem: To evaluate whether long-term memory systems for LLM agents can maintain a correct *current* world state under multi-session updates with inter-entity dependencies—specifically covering dependency propagation (Cascade), uncertainty after upstream changes (Absence), and post-removal consistency (Deletion), which prior benchmarks largely do not score.
summary_en.importance: The paper shifts the diagnostic target from “retrieval quality” to “state consistency under updates.” Many systems store both the update event and the dependency rule, yet still answer with stale values because retrieval ranking and response behavior privilege older facts. For pretraining-oriented researchers, MEME is useful as a controlled, verifiable testbed to study where to place computation (ingest-time normalization/propagation vs. query-time reasoning) and what training signals might be missing if we want models to robustly handle evolving state across sessions.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MEME defines a 2D taxonomy: entity scope (single vs. multi-entity) × temporal dynamics (static vs. evolving), then instantiates six tasks that intentionally avoid already-covered easy variants:
- Exact Recall (single/static, verbatim fidelity)
- Aggregation (multi/static, cross-session coverage)
- Tracking (single/evolving, full revision history)
- Deletion (single/evolving, stop reporting removed facts)
- Cascade (multi/evolving, propagate updates through explicit dependency rules)
- Absence (multi/evolving, recognize uncertainty when upstream changes invalidate a dependent fact without a replacement rule)

Data is generated from a DAG knowledge graph with explicit conditional rules, enabling gold answers by construction. A key methodological step is an “in-context solvability” check: feeding gold facts directly to the answering LLM to confirm the tasks are solvable in principle, isolating failures to memory write/retrieve/update mechanisms.

The main diagnosis is retrieval-time failure: stale values outrank update events (notably in vector retrieval), or tool/graph/sparse retrieval fails to surface the right evidence, so the answering LLM defaults to the earlier value. The only strong closure reported comes from moving propagation to ingest-time: a strong internal LLM writes the propagated value into the store so retrieval becomes a direct lookup of the current value.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate six memory systems spanning three paradigms (raw chunk retrieval, LLM-processed memory, file-based/tool-managed memory) on 100 controlled episodes across two domains (Personal Life, Software Project).

Headline results: under default settings, all practical-cost configurations collapse on dependency reasoning—Cascade ~3% average accuracy and Absence ~1% (also reported near 0.03/0.01 scale). Static retrieval-style tasks can look acceptable, highlighting that the bottleneck is not basic recall.

Robustness checks (prompt tuning, deeper retrieval, less filler noise, stronger answering LLM) do not materially close the gap.

A notable exception is an ingest-time propagation setup (MD-flat with an Opus 4.7 internal LLM), which improves by writing propagated values into memory, but at ~70× the baseline cost—making the compute-placement trade-off explicit.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task taxonomy and examples (Figure 1/2) to internalize what Cascade/Absence/Deletion require—Absence in particular hinges on answering “unknown/uncertain” rather than repeating stale facts. Then read the DAG-based generation and rule formalization to understand why gold labels are verifiable. Spend most time on the failure analysis section that separates “stored but not surfaced” from “never stored,” and on the ingest-time propagation case study (Opus 4.7) because it clarifies a concrete design lever: shifting reasoning from query-time to write-time. Skimming time ~30–45 minutes; deeper reading needed if you plan to reproduce or redesign retrieval/ranking.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆能力的系统性基准工作，重点看§3的任务设计和§5的错误模式分析，对长期记忆预训练目标设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A systematic benchmark for agent memory capabilities; focus on §3 task design and §5 error pattern analysis, with reference value for long-term memory pretraining objective design.

institutions: Tübingen AI Center, University of Tübingen

paper.title: SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis
paper.abstract: Skills are a promising way to improve LLM agent capabilities without retraining, while keeping the added procedure reusable and controllable. However, high-quality skills are still largely written by hand. We introduce SkillGen, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes a single auditable skill from trajectories generated by a base agent. The output is a human-readable artifact that can be inspected before use. Rather than merely summarizing trajectories, SkillGen leverages contrastive induction

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent自动技能合成方法仅从成功轨迹学习，未对同任务下的成功与失败轨迹做对比分析，同时缺乏对生成技能的净收益验证，可能引入新的错误模式，无法保证技能对Agent性能的正向提升。
summary.importance: SkillGen将技能合成建模为干预问题，明确了技能质量的量化验证标准；其对比归纳思路也为预训练阶段从正负样本中提取通用行为模式、优化训练信号质量提供了可迁移的方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: SkillGen是三智能体协作的自动化技能合成框架：1. 对比归纳智能体同时分析成功与失败轨迹，提取可复用的成功模式、常见失败模式，以及成功轨迹中存在但失败轨迹中缺失的关键行为；2. 生成智能体基于诊断结果生成候选技能；3. 验证智能体在独立验证集上测试候选技能的净收益（修复错误的收益减去引入新错误的损失），通过迭代优化循环筛选出性能正向的最终技能，输出为人类可读、可审计的推理时干预文件，无需修改模型权重。
summary.experiments: 在交互任务、科学任务、代码任务、工具使用等多类基准上测试，覆盖8款开源与闭源基础LLM：SkillGen为所有基础模型带来3.27到10.08个百分点的离线测试精度提升，性能优于现有所有技能合成基线；消融实验验证对比归纳、验证引导的迭代优化、净收益筛选三个模块均对性能增益有独立贡献；生成的技能可跨模型迁移，不依赖生成轨迹的基础模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读Introduction中现有方法的两类缺陷分析，以及Methodology中对比归纳的具体实现和净收益验证的定义；实验部分关注跨模型迁移的测试结果，理解技能的泛化特性，总阅读时间约30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing automated skill synthesis methods for LLM agents learn only from successful trajectories, without conducting contrastive analysis between successful and failed trajectories on the same task. They also lack verification of the net benefit of generated skills, which may introduce new failure modes and cannot guarantee positive performance improvement for the base agent.
summary_en.importance: SkillGen models skill synthesis as an interventional problem and defines a quantifiable verification standard for skill quality. Its contrastive induction paradigm also provides transferable methodological guidance for extracting general behavior patterns from positive and negative samples and improving training signal quality during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillGen is a multi-agent framework for automated skill synthesis with three specialized agents: 1. A contrastive induction agent analyzes both successful and failed trajectories to extract reusable success patterns, recurring failure modes, and critical behaviors present in successes but absent in failures; 2. A generation agent produces candidate skills based on the diagnostics; 3. A verification agent tests the net effect of candidate skills on an independent validation set (gains from repaired failures minus losses from newly introduced errors), and selects the final skill with positive overall performance through an iterative refinement loop. The output is a human-readable, auditable inference-time intervention artifact that requires no model weight updates.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across interactive, scientific, coding, and tool-use benchmarks with 8 open-weight and proprietary base LLMs: SkillGen delivers held-out accuracy gains ranging from +3.27 to +10.08 percentage points for all base models, outperforming all existing skill synthesis baselines. Ablation studies confirm that contrastive induction, verification-guided refinement, and net-effect filtering each contribute independently to performance gains. Generated skills are transferable across models and not tied to the base LLM that produced the training trajectories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of two key limitations of existing methods in the Introduction, as well as the implementation of contrastive induction and the definition of net-effect verification in Methodology. In the experiments section, pay attention to cross-model transfer test results to understand the generalization property of skills. Estimated reading time: ~30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法部分的对比归纳和技能验证设计，做Agent基座预训练的研究员可参考技能注入的思路。
recommendation.en: Only read the contrastive induction and skill verification design in the method section, useful for researchers working on agent foundation pre-training.

institutions: Munich Center for Machine Learning, LMU Munich

paper.title: GameGen-Verifier: Parallel Keypoint-Based Verification for LLM-Generated Games via Runtime State Injection
paper.abstract: LLM-based game generation promises to turn natural-language specifications into executable games, but progress is limited by the lack of reliable automated verification. Unlike conventional code generation, game correctness is defined over long-horizon interaction: a game may appear correct while violating core mechanics such as state updates, interaction rules, and phase transitions. Existing Agent-as-a-Verifier approaches collapse verification into open-ended gameplay, making verdicts reachabi

summary.core_problem: LLM生成游戏缺乏可靠的自动化验证——游戏正确性由长程交互定义，而现有Agent-as-a-Verifier方法将验证坍缩为开放式游戏玩法，存在可达性边界、耗时、覆盖有限等问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出基于关键点的并行验证范式GameGen-Verifier，将规范分解为可验证关键点并独立注入运行时状态进行验证。
summary.technical_approach: 将游戏规范分解为可验证关键点，每个关键点注入游戏运行时到特定目标状态，执行有界交互并根据关键点断言判断结果，实现并行验证。
summary.experiments: 实现了GGV-Harness可扩展代理框架，在120个LLM生成的游戏上与Agent-as-a-Verifier对比，具体提升数值未在摘要中完整列出。
summary.authors_note: Lionrock AI Lab和独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based game generation lacks reliable automated verification — game correctness depends on long-horizon interactions, and existing Agent-as-a-Verifier approaches reduce verification to open-ended gameplay with reachability bounds and coverage limits.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: GameGen-Verifier, a parallel keypoint-based verification paradigm that decomposes specs into verifiable keypoints with runtime state injection.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes game specs into verifiable keypoints; each unit patches game runtime into a target state, executes bounded interaction, and judges against keypoint assertions — enabling parallel verification.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented GGV-Harness scalable agentic harness; compared against Agent-as-a-Verifier on 120 LLM-generated games. Exact improvement metrics not fully available in the abstract snippet.
summary_en.authors_note: Lionrock AI Lab + independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 游戏生成领域的验证方法，对agent验证方法论有微弱启发但过于垂直，了解思路即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Domain-specific verification approach for game generation. Marginally inspiring for agent verification methodology but too niche — skim the idea only.

paper.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries
paper.abstract: Skill-augmented agents increasingly rely on large reusable skill libraries, but retrieving relevant skills is not the same as presenting usable context. Existing methods typically return atomic skills or dependency-aware bundles whose internal roles remain implicit, leaving the agent to infer the execution entry point, support skills, visible requirements, and failure-avoidance guidance. We introduce Group of Skills (GoSkills), an inference-time group-structured retrieval method that changes the

summary.core_problem: 解决技能库 agent 在检索阶段只返回原子技能列表，导致执行入口、支持技能、检查条件和规避信息都需要模型自行推断的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent inference-time 设计，不是基座模型研究。价值在于把 skill retrieval 的返回对象从平面列表改成带角色结构的执行上下文，对工具使用和规划接口设计有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GoSkills：基于类型化技能图构建以 anchor 为中心的技能组，再通过 group graph 扩展支持组，最后压缩成有限原子技能载荷，并渲染为固定执行契约，包含 Start、Support、Check、Avoid 四类字段。整个方法不改下游 agent、本体技能或执行环境。
summary.experiments: 在 SkillsBench 和 ALFWorld 上验证。摘要强调其为 inference-time 方法，比较对象应是原子技能检索或依赖感知 bundle 检索，但未给出具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between retrieving atomic skills and providing actually usable execution context for skill-library agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-interface paper, not foundation-model research. Its main value is the idea of changing the retrieval output from a flat list into a role-structured execution context, which may be mildly useful for tool-use interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GoSkills builds anchor-centered skill groups from a typed skill graph, expands support groups through a group graph, compresses the selected plan into a bounded set of atomic skill payloads, and renders a fixed execution contract with Start, Support, Check, and Avoid fields.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on SkillsBench and ALFWorld. The abstract positions it against atomic-skill retrieval and dependency-aware bundles, but does not provide concrete gains in the summary.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 工程，和 pretrain 关系不大；如果你关心 tool-use 接口，只看“固定执行契约”这个表示层设计，别花时间读全篇。
recommendation.en: Mostly agent engineering, not pretraining; if you care about tool-use interfaces, just inspect the fixed execution contract idea and skip the rest.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: AI Co-Mathematician: Accelerating Mathematicians with Agentic AI
paper.abstract: We introduce the AI co-mathematician, a workbench for mathematicians to interactively leverage AI agents to pursue open-ended research. The AI co-mathematician is optimized to provide holistic support for the exploratory and iterative reality of mathematical workflows, including ideation, literature search, computational exploration, theorem proving and theory building. By providing an asynchronous, stateful workspace that manages uncertainty, refines user intent, tracks failed hypotheses, and o

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的不是单题数学推理能力，而是数学研究中的长期协作编排问题。标准聊天界面适合短回合问答，形式化证明器和搜索系统适合局部任务，但数学研究需要持续管理假设、失败路径、文献线索、计算实验和中间证明草稿。AI Co-Mathematician 试图把这些活动放进一个有状态、可异步推进的 agent 工作台。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，因为系统不依赖新的模型训练，也不提出新的语言建模目标。启发主要在两个方面。第一，数学能力评估不应只看静态题集，长期状态管理、假设修订、反例搜索和用户意图澄清会成为推理模型的重要使用场景。第二，这类工作台可以反过来产生更接近真实数学研究过程的数据，包括失败假设、审稿式反驳、文献追踪和多轮定义修订，这些数据比单一答案监督更适合训练研究型推理模型。
summary.technical_approach: 系统是一个基于 Gemini 模型的 agent harness，而不是定制模型。核心设计是用 project coordinator agent 管理项目状态，并把任务拆成并行 workstreams。每个 workstream 可承担不同角色，例如构造例子、搜索文献、尝试证明、寻找反例、写计算脚本或整理中间结果。用户不是等待端到端自动证明，而是在工作区中持续 steering：修改目标、约束搜索方向、确认有用定义、丢弃失败分支。文中强调两类机制。一类是状态化记忆，包括跟踪失败假设、未解决子问题、可复用 lemma 和文献引用；另一类是 adversarial review loop，用审查和反驳减少系统走捷径或把不可解问题包装成似是而非的证明。与 AlphaProof、Aletheia、AlphaEvolve 这类专用推理或搜索引擎不同，它的重点是把这些能力放进人类研究循环，而不是替代底层 solver。
summary.experiments: 实验部分以早期定性结果和静态 benchmark 基线为主。可见内容显示，系统在试用中帮助数学研究者处理开放问题、发现新的研究方向、补充被忽略的文献线索，并生成可验证的数学 artifacts。文中也说明会给出静态问题求解 benchmark，用作底层能力测量，但提供的内容没有包含具体题集、模型版本、成功率或 ablation 数字。因而不宜把它读成数学推理能力提升的定量证明，更适合作为 agentic mathematics workflow 的系统设计案例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看设计原则、系统 walkthrough 和 evaluation strategy。重点关注三件事：一是 coordinator 如何维护项目状态；二是并行 workstreams 如何避免互相污染并保留失败路径；三是评估部分如何处理开放式数学研究中“没有单一标准答案”的问题。静态 benchmark 部分可快速扫过，因为它只能反映底层模型的单点能力，不能充分评价这个系统真正关心的长期协作能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets orchestration rather than single-shot mathematical reasoning. Current chat interfaces handle local interactions, while theorem provers and search systems handle specialized subproblems. Real mathematical research requires persistent management of hypotheses, failed attempts, literature traces, computational probes, and evolving proof artifacts. AI Co-Mathematician is designed as a stateful, asynchronous workspace for that workflow.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to pretraining is limited: the system does not introduce a new model, training objective, or custom model behavior. Its relevance is in the interface between reasoning models, evaluation, and future data generation. It suggests that mathematical capability should be evaluated not only on static problem sets, but also on long-horizon state tracking, refutation, intent refinement, and theory-building. It may also produce richer supervision traces for future reasoning models, including failed hypotheses, adversarial reviews, literature grounding, and iterative definition repair.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is a harness built on Gemini models. A project coordinator agent maintains the global research state and delegates tasks to parallel workstreams. These workstreams can explore examples, search literature, attempt proofs, find counterexamples, run computations, and draft intermediate artifacts. The user remains in the loop and steers the process by changing constraints, accepting useful directions, and pruning unproductive branches. Two design choices matter most: persistent project memory, including failed hypotheses and reusable lemmas; and adversarial review loops that challenge weak arguments instead of allowing the system to produce polished but unreliable claims. Unlike AlphaProof, Aletheia, or AlphaEvolve, the focus is not a specialized solver, but the orchestration layer that can place such solvers inside a human research loop.
summary_en.experiments: The evidence is mainly early qualitative feedback plus baseline static problem-solving evaluations. The available text reports that practicing mathematicians used the system to make progress on open-ended problems, identify new directions, and recover overlooked references. It also says the system is evaluated on static benchmarks to measure underlying capability, but the provided content does not include concrete benchmark names, model versions, success rates, or ablations. The results should therefore be read as a system-design demonstration, not as a quantitative claim about improved mathematical reasoning ability.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the design principles, the walkthrough, and the evaluation discussion. The most useful details are how the coordinator preserves project state, how parallel workstreams are organized, and how the system evaluates progress when there is no single final answer. The static benchmark section can be read quickly, because it mostly measures the underlying model and does not capture the long-horizon collaborative behavior that motivates the system.

recommendation.zh: Google的Agent数学助手，核心价值在于展示了有状态工作空间+失败假设追踪对复杂推理任务的重要性，对LLM推理能力的研究有参考意义。重点看系统架构和FrontierMath基准上的表现。
recommendation.en: Google's agentic math assistant demonstrating the value of stateful workspace and failed hypothesis tracking for complex reasoning. Study the system architecture and FrontierMath benchmark results.

paper.title: PRAISE: Prefix-Based Rollout Reuse in Agentic Search Training
paper.abstract: In agentic search, large language models (LLMs) are trained to perform multi-turn retrieval and reasoning for complex tasks such as multi-hop question answering (QA). However, current search-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods suffer from two core limitations: expensive long-horizon rollouts are under-utilized during training, and supervision is typically available only at the final answer, resulting in severe reward sparsity. We present Prefix-based Rollout reuse for Agentic search with I

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic search 中 RLVR 奖励过稀、过程监督又常常与最终结果不对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心增量，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有启发：如果模型需要通过多步检索和外部交互来扩展能力，如何构造与最终 outcome 一致的中间训练信号，是后续 tool-use、search policy、甚至合成训练轨迹时都会遇到的问题。论文的价值不在提出一个通用 RL 新算法，而在于把“过程奖励要和最终可验证目标对齐”这件事做得更具体，并且避免了固定 evaluator 与 evolving policy 的失配。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 OASES。核心做法是把中间 search state 也放到最终任务的 outcome metric 下评估，而不是用相似度、启发式规则或外部 judge 打分。具体来说，给定某一步搜索状态下已经积累的证据，evaluator 基于当前状态生成一个 state-conditioned answer，再用与最终答案相同的可验证指标去打分；相邻状态之间这个分数的提升，就被当作 dense process reward。这样得到的奖励信号直接对应“这一步搜索是否让最终答案更可回答”，而不是“这一步看起来是否相关”。

第二个关键设计是 search–evaluation co-training：作者不单独训练一个冻结的 reward model 或 evaluator，而是让同一个共享参数模型同时承担 search policy 和 state evaluator 的角色，并用 PPO 优化。这样做是为了解决 evaluator–policy mismatch：如果 evaluator 固定不变，它看到的状态分布和当前 policy 生成的真实搜索轨迹会逐渐偏离；如果直接用外部模型算 likelihood gain，也可能和当前 policy 的行为不一致。OASES 让 evaluator 随 policy 一起更新，试图让过程奖励始终贴近当前策略的真实搜索分布。

从方法定位看，它更像 outcome-aligned process supervision，而不是传统意义上的 reward shaping。因为它没有引入一个与最终目标不同的代理目标，而是把最终目标投影到中间状态上。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 multi-hop QA 的 agentic search 场景上，结论是 OASES 相比强 RL baseline 能稳定提升搜索表现。摘要和引言明确给出的结论包括：1）outcome-aligned process rewards 比只用最终 outcome reward 的 RLVR 更有效，说明稠密信用分配确实有帮助；2）shared-policy 的 search–evaluation co-training 优于 frozen evaluator 或只优化 search policy 的替代方案，说明 evaluator–policy mismatch 不是边缘问题，而是会实质影响训练质量。

从阅读重点看，正文里最值得确认的是三类实验：一是主结果相对 PPO/RLVR baseline 的提升幅度；二是 process reward 的消融，例如与 heuristic reward、retrieval relevance reward、likelihood/information-gain reward 的比较；三是 evaluator 设计的消融，即共享参数、冻结 evaluator、分离 evaluator 三种设置谁更稳。若论文还报告了 rollout reuse 或 prefix reuse 带来的 sample efficiency 改善，那部分更偏训练效率，但不是这篇工作的主要研究价值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看方法总图和 reward 定义，再看消融，不必在环境细节上停留太久。重点确认两件事：第一，state-conditioned answer 的打分是否真的避免了答案泄漏或过早拟合 gold answer；第二，共享 evaluator 是否会带来自举偏差，即模型既当裁判又当选手时会不会奖励自己偏好的轨迹。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要思想；若只关心对训练信号设计的启发，主实验表、reward ablation、co-training ablation 三处足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central difficulty in RL training for agentic search: outcome rewards are sparse and delayed, while existing process rewards are often misaligned with the final objective or become unreliable as the policy evolves.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Once models are trained to use tools, search, or external evidence, the quality of intermediate supervision becomes a bottleneck. The useful idea here is not a new general RL algorithm, but a cleaner way to derive dense process rewards from the same verifiable objective used at the end of the trajectory, while reducing evaluator–policy mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach:
OASES builds dense process rewards by evaluating intermediate search states with the final outcome metric itself. At each search state, given the evidence accumulated so far, an evaluator generates a state-conditioned answer. That answer is then scored with the same verifiable metric used for the final answer, such as exact match or F1. The score improvement between consecutive states becomes the process reward. This makes the reward signal answer-oriented rather than proxy-oriented: the question is whether a search step makes the final answer more supportable, not whether it merely looks relevant.

The second key design is search–evaluation co-training. Instead of using a separate frozen evaluator, external judge, or fixed likelihood model, OASES uses a shared-parameter model as both the search policy and the state evaluator, optimized with PPO. The motivation is to reduce evaluator–policy mismatch. A frozen evaluator may become stale as the policy changes its search behavior, while likelihood-based evaluators can be inconsistent with the policy’s own generation dynamics under partial prefixes. Jointly training search and evaluation is meant to keep the process reward adaptive to the current policy distribution.

Conceptually, this is closer to outcome-aligned process supervision than to conventional reward shaping, because it does not replace the final objective with a different proxy objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are conducted on multi-hop QA benchmarks in an agentic search setting. The main reported finding is that OASES consistently improves over strong RL baselines for search. The paper also claims that outcome-aligned process rewards provide better credit assignment than outcome-only RLVR, and that search–evaluation co-training outperforms alternatives based on frozen evaluators or search-only optimization.

The most important details to verify in the full paper are: the absolute gain over PPO/RLVR baselines, comparisons against other process-reward formulations such as heuristic relevance or likelihood-based information gain, and ablations on evaluator design. If the paper also includes rollout or prefix reuse for sample efficiency, that is useful from a training-efficiency angle, but it is secondary to the main contribution, which is the reward construction and co-training setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the method overview first, then the exact reward definition, then the ablations. There are two questions worth checking carefully. First, does the state-conditioned answer evaluation avoid answer leakage or premature fitting to the gold answer? Second, does using the same model as both policy and evaluator introduce self-reinforcing bias? If your interest is mainly in training-signal design, the main results table, reward ablations, and co-training ablations are enough. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be sufficient.

recommendation.zh: Prefix rollout复用和step-level奖励推导是Agent RL训练中值得关注的数据效率改进方向，主要看方法部分（§3）即可。
recommendation.en: Prefix rollout reuse and step-level reward derivation are interesting directions for data-efficient Agent RL training; focus on the method section (§3).

paper.title: Self-Improvement for Fast, High-Quality Plan Generation
paper.abstract: Generative models trained on synthetic plan data are a promising approach to generalized planning. Recent work has focused on finding any valid plan, rather than a high-quality solution. We address the challenge of producing high-quality plans, a computationally hard problem, in sub-exponential time. First, we demonstrate that, given optimal data, a decoder-only transformer can generate high-quality plans for unseen problem instances. Second, we show how to self-improve an initial model trained

summary.core_problem: 研究如何让生成模型在规划任务中快速产生高质量计划，而不只是找到任意可行解。
